classes.name: Druid
classes.summary: A guardian of nature wielding primordial magic and wild shape.
classes.proficiencies: Light and medium armor, shields, simple weapons, herbalist tools.
classes.spellcasting: Primordial spells (prepared). Ring spells always prepared.

abilities.name: Druidic
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Secret language of druids.

You know Druidic. You can leave hidden messages in natural elements that only druids understand. Others spot the message with a successful Insight (Perception) check but cannot decipher it without magic.

abilities.name: Nature's Gift
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Channel ambient energy to heal.

As an action, choose one creature within 5 feet (can be yourself). Roll a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus (minimum 2d4). That creature heals Wounds equal to the total. No effect on Constructs or Undead.

Uses per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Prepared Primordial spells.

As a conduit for Primordial magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Druid progression table.

You prepare spells in advance. You can prepare a number of spells equal to your Insight (INS) modifier + your druid level (minimum one). Change your prepared list during a long rest.

Spellcasting ability: Insight (INS). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Insight (INS) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

abilities.name: Wild Shape
abilities.summary: Channel nature for beast forms and spell recovery.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Channel nature for beast forms and spell recovery.

You channel nature as a free action (Beast Form) or action (Draw Power). Uses per rest on your progression table.

  • Beast Form. Assume a known beast form. See Improved Beast Form for CR limits by level.
  • Draw Power. Recover one expended spell level up to your proficiency bonus. Cannot use while transformed.

abilities.name: Improved Beast Form
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Assume more powerful beast forms.

When you learn beast forms, maximum CR by level:

  • 3rd: CR ¼
  • 5th: CR ½
  • 7th: CR 1
  • 9th: CR 2

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a magic talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a magic talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the magic talents list.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Rite of the Kingdom or Shaper.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Rite of the Kingdom or Shaper.

Choose one:

  • Rite of the Kingdom. Communicate basic ideas with Beasts; advantage on checks to influence them.
  • Rite of the Shaper. When combat begins with no Wild Shape uses left, regain one use (once per long rest).

abilities.name: Nature's Grace
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Attunement sustains and protects you.

You cannot be magically aged. You do not need food or water. Your ability modifiers and Max Wounds cannot be lowered except by a wish.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Unlimited wild shape; effortless spellcasting.

Archdruid. Wild Shape (Beast Form) has unlimited uses. You can ignore verbal and somatic components of Primordial spells, and material components without a listed cost.

subclasses.name: Leaf
subclasses.summary: Guardian of growing things and peaceful wild places.

features.name: Green Song
features.summary: Speak with plants; inspect flora with an action.
features.descriptionHtml:
Speak with plants; inspect flora with an action.

As an action, focus on a nonmagical plant within 30 feet to learn if it is edible, poisonous, its typical environment, and its condition. Plant creatures understand your speech and you understand theirs.

features.name: Leaf Ring Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared leaf ring spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared leaf ring spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: barkskin, entangle, goodberry, spike growth
  • Level 5: plant growth, speak with plants
  • Level 7: blight, freedom of movement
  • Level 9: greater hold, tree stride

features.name: Wild Shape: Sacred Grove
features.summary: Wild Shape creates a magical pocket grove.
features.descriptionHtml:
Wild Shape creates a magical pocket grove.

Expend Wild Shape as an action to create a 10-foot-radius sacred grove for 1 minute (one at a time). Choose one property:

  • Tangle Weed: difficult terrain; reaction to restrain movers (Fitness save vs spell DC).
  • Tree Line: disadvantage on attacks against creatures in the grove; reaction to intercept one attack against you on solid ground (grove destroyed).
  • Wildflowers: advantage vs charmed/frightened; bonus action to destroy grove and end one creature's conditions—allies on solid ground gain temp Wounds = PB.

features.name: Take Root
features.summary: Bonus action root yourself; spend hit dice for healing while rooted.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus action root yourself; spend hit dice for healing while rooted.

As a free action on solid ground, root in place (speed 0, can't be moved or knocked prone) until you end it. If rooted when your turn begins, spend one hit die to regain Wounds = roll + Fitness modifier.

features.name: Grove Warden
features.summary: Sacred grove expands to 30 feet; choose who is immune to its effects.
features.descriptionHtml:
Sacred grove expands to 30 feet; choose who is immune to its effects.

Sacred Grove radius becomes 30 feet. You decide whether each ally (including yourself) is immune to any effects the grove imposes.

features.name: Heart of the Forest
features.summary: Grove saves you at 0 Wounds; acorn resurrection if destroyed.
features.descriptionHtml:
Grove saves you at 0 Wounds; acorn resurrection if destroyed.

At 0 Wounds inside your sacred grove, the grove withers and you regain Wounds equal to your druid level (once per long rest). If your body is destroyed, an acorn remains; if undisturbed or planted, you gain a new body in 1d10 days with full Wounds.

subclasses.name: Shifter
subclasses.summary: Master of beast forms and primal transformation.

features.name: Potent Forms
features.summary: Higher-CR beast forms; speak while transformed.
features.descriptionHtml:
Higher-CR beast forms; speak while transformed.

Choose beast forms with CR up to 1 (scaling with level per Improved Beast Form). You use the creature's Max Wounds when you transform. You can speak languages you know in beast form but still can't cast spells.

features.name: Quick Shift
features.summary: Beast Form as a free action.
features.descriptionHtml:
Beast Form as a free action.

When you use Beast Form, you can transform as a free action instead of an action.

features.name: Shifter Ring Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared shifter ring spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared shifter ring spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: alter self, animal friendship, speak with animals
  • Level 5: conjure animals, water breathing
  • Level 7: giant insect, polymorph
  • Level 9: dominate, insect plague

features.name: Beast's Fury
features.summary: Bonus natural attack after Attack action in beast form.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus natural attack after Attack action in beast form.

After you take the Attack action in beast form, you can use your second action (if you haven't moved) to make one natural weapon attack for 1d6 + PB damage. Melee damage in beast form counts as magical.

features.name: Elemental Infusion
features.summary: Infuse beast form with air, earth, fire, or water power.
features.descriptionHtml:
Infuse beast form with air, earth, fire, or water power.

Expend two Wild Shape uses to infuse your beast form with an elemental power (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water), gaining movement, resistance, and a rechargeable action per BFRD Shifter. Alternatively, spend one use as a reaction to switch infusion while transformed.

features.name: Manifold Mind
features.summary: Cast spells in beast form.
features.descriptionHtml:
Cast spells in beast form.

You can cast Primordial spells while in beast form, performing verbal and somatic components normally. Material components still apply.

subclasses.name: Elementalist
subclasses.summary: Command acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder to protect nature.

features.name: Elemental Convergence
features.summary: Bonus elemental cantrip; convert damage dice between elemental types.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus elemental cantrip; convert damage dice between elemental types.

Learn one cantrip from: acid splash, electric jolt, firebolt, hoarfrost, ray of frost, or shocking grasp. It counts as Primordial and doesn't count against cantrips known. Switch it when you finish a long rest. When you deal damage with one of these cantrips, add extra damage of its type equal to your PB.

When you deal acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can change any number of damage dice to one of the other listed types.

features.name: Elementalist Ring Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared elementalist ring spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared elementalist ring spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: acid arrow, burning hands, shatter, thunderwave
  • Level 5: call lightning, fireball
  • Level 7: conjure minor elementals, elemental shield
  • Level 9: cone of cold, conjure elemental

features.name: Wild Shape: Elemental Conduit
features.summary: Wild Shape becomes an elemental conduit with reactive powers.
features.descriptionHtml:
Wild Shape becomes an elemental conduit with reactive powers.

As a free action, expend Wild Shape to become a living elemental conduit for 10 minutes (or until dismissed, incapacitated, or dead).

As a reaction while active, choose one:

  • Elemental Absorption: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, become resistant to that type until your next turn (immune if already resistant).
  • Elemental Empowerment: When you deal elemental damage, reroll damage dice up to your Willpower modifier (minimum 1).
  • Elemental Enervation: When a creature within 30 feet succeeds on a save vs. elemental damage, force it to reroll.

features.name: Elemental Deflection
features.summary: Reaction: grant an ally resistance to incoming elemental damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reaction: grant an ally resistance to incoming elemental damage.

As a reaction when a friendly creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, that creature becomes resistant to that type (including the triggering effect) until the start of its next turn. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Elemental Bulwark
features.summary: Elemental conduit grants broad resistances and condition immunity.
features.descriptionHtml:
Elemental conduit grants broad resistances and condition immunity.

While using Elemental Conduit, you are resistant to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage and immune to paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, and unconscious.

features.name: Elemental Flare
features.summary: Retaliate with elemental damage; extended conduit with movement modes.
features.descriptionHtml:
Retaliate with elemental damage; extended conduit with movement modes.

As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you, it takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice) equal to half your druid level (rounded down).

Elemental Conduit now lasts 1 hour. While active, you gain burrowing, flying (hover), and swimming speeds equal to your walking speed.

subclasses.name: Fey
subclasses.summary: Summon seelie spirits and wield mercurial fey magic.

features.name: Enchanting Presence
features.summary: Speak Sylvan; use Willpower for social checks vs. fey.
features.descriptionHtml:
Speak Sylvan; use Willpower for social checks vs. fey.

You know Sylvan. Use your Willpower modifier instead of another ability on Willpower checks, and have advantage on Willpower checks when interacting with Fey.

features.name: Fey Ring Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared fey ring spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared fey ring spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: charm, disguise self, misty step, suggestion
  • Level 5: conjure animals, major image
  • Level 7: conjure woodland beings, dimension door
  • Level 9: seeming, tree stride

features.name: Wild Shape: Seelie Spirit
features.summary: Wild Shape summons a seasonal fey spirit with spectral effects.
features.descriptionHtml:
Wild Shape summons a seasonal fey spirit with spectral effects.

As a free action, expend Wild Shape to summon a spectral fey spirit within 60 feet (not a creature; doesn't occupy space). Choose a season (spring, summer, autumn, winter) per the Seelie Seasons table. Move it up to 30 feet and trigger its effect as a free action on your turn. Lasts 1 minute or until dismissed, incapacitated, or you end your turn more than 120 feet away.

  • Spring — Euphoric Perfume: One ally within 5 feet has advantage on its next save before your next turn.
  • Summer — Fey Ferocity: One ally within 5 feet has advantage on its next attack before your next turn.
  • Autumn — Enchanting Distraction: One hostile within 5 feet has disadvantage on its next attack before your next turn.
  • Winter — Sorrowful Rebuke: When a chosen ally within 5 feet takes damage from a creature within 10 feet, that attacker makes a Fitness save vs. your spell DC or takes cold damage equal to your PB.

features.name: Mercurial Magic
features.summary: Resist charm/unconscious; reaction to aid allies' saves vs. fey effects.
features.descriptionHtml:
Resist charm/unconscious; reaction to aid allies' saves vs. fey effects.

You are resistant to charmed and unconscious. As a reaction when a friendly creature within 60 feet (including you) makes a save vs. charmed, frightened, poisoned, unconscious, or a Fey effect, grant advantage on that save. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Superior Seelie
features.summary: Season spirits gain stronger seasonal effects and longer duration.
features.descriptionHtml:
Season spirits gain stronger seasonal effects and longer duration.

Seelie Spirit effects range increases to 15 feet (20 for Sorrowful Rebuke). Spirit lasts up to 10 minutes. Each season gains a second effect:

  • Spring's Vigor: Next hit by target grants temp Wounds = PB.
  • Summer's Exuberance: +10 ft speed until your next turn.
  • Autumn's Charm: Hostile creature makes WIL save or is charmed until your next turn.
  • Winter's Grasp: Hostile creature makes FIT save or is restrained until your next turn.

features.name: Archfey's Blessing
features.summary: Ageless fey resilience; twin spirits with extended range.
features.descriptionHtml:
Ageless fey resilience; twin spirits with extended range.

You can't die of old age. Immune to charmed and unconscious; resistant to frightened and poisoned.

Seelie Spirit range becomes 30 feet (40 for Sorrowful Rebuke), move 60 feet, and you can summon two spirits of different seasons per use, controlling both with one free action.

subclasses.name: Stoneheart
subclasses.summary: Wrap yourself in earthen armor and stand as nature's sentinel.

features.name: Stone Intuition
features.summary: Enhanced shillelagh; advantage identifying stone and metal work.
features.descriptionHtml:
Enhanced shillelagh; advantage identifying stone and metal work.

Learn shillelagh if you don't know it. Your shillelagh club or quarterstaff becomes stone (non-flammable, light as wood). You can shape a 1-foot cube of stone or earth into a club or quarterstaff.

Advantage on checks to determine the origin or purpose of metal or stone objects and structures.

features.name: Stoneheart Ring Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared stoneheart ring spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared stoneheart ring spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: boulder toss, circle of stones, entangle, shield of faith
  • Level 5: elemental fusion (earth only), meld into stone
  • Level 7: stone shape, stoneskin
  • Level 9: conjure elemental (earth only), wall of stone

features.name: Wild Shape: Earthen Armor
features.summary: Wild Shape wraps you in protective earth armor.
features.descriptionHtml:
Wild Shape wraps you in protective earth armor.

As a free action while not wearing armor, expend Wild Shape to don earthen armor for hours equal to your PB (or until you expend another use).

  • Shillelagh damage die becomes d10.
  • Burrowing speed equal to walking speed.
  • Tremorsense 10 feet.
  • AC = 13 + Willpower modifier.

features.name: Stone's Vengeance
features.summary: Two attacks; earth pillars impose disadvantage on ally attacks.
features.descriptionHtml:
Two attacks; earth pillars impose disadvantage on ally attacks.

When you take the Attack action, make two attacks.

When a friendly creature within 30 feet on the ground is attacked, summon a pillar to impose disadvantage on the attack. If it still hits, the attacker takes bludgeoning damage equal to your druid level. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Stone Sentinel
features.summary: Improved earthen armor: d12 shillelagh, AC 15 + WIL, silent burrowing.
features.descriptionHtml:
Improved earthen armor: d12 shillelagh, AC 15 + WIL, silent burrowing.

While Earthen Armor is active:

  • Shillelagh damage die becomes d12.
  • Double damage to objects/structures with metal or stone weapons.
  • Burrowing doesn't disturb material.
  • AC = 15 + Willpower modifier.
  • Tremorsense 20 feet.

features.name: Stone Heart
features.summary: Resist acid and bludgeoning; immune while armored with temp Wounds each turn.
features.descriptionHtml:
Resist acid and bludgeoning; immune while armored with temp Wounds each turn.

Resistant to acid and bludgeoning. While Earthen Armor is active, immune to those types instead and gain temp Wounds equal to your PB at the start of each of your turns.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.summary: A master of weapons and battlefield tactics with action surge and martial actions.
classes.proficiencies: All armor and shields; simple and martial weapons.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Emergency healing when badly wounded.

When damage would bring your Wounds above half your Max Wounds, you can use your reaction to spend hit dice (up to your proficiency bonus). Roll them and heal Wounds equal to the total + your Fitness modifier.

abilities.name: Martial Action
abilities.summary: Tactical second action when you hold your ground.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Tactical second action when you hold your ground.

Choose one martial action: Aim, Guard, Quick Strike, or Wind Up (see BFRD Fighter).

In YMIAT, use this as your second action when you have not moved this turn. If the second action is an attack, that attack is at disadvantage.

abilities.name: Action Surge
abilities.summary: Gain an additional action on your turn.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Gain an additional action on your turn.

On your turn, gain another action in addition to your normal action. Once per short rest at 2nd level; twice at 7th; three times at 10th (still only once per turn).

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a martial talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a martial talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the martial talents list.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Multiple attacks per Attack action.

Make two attacks with the Attack action at 3rd level, three at 6th, and four at 9th.

In YMIAT, each successful weapon attack typically inflicts 1 Wound (2 on a critical hit).

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Defiant saves or unstoppable recovery.

Choose one:

  • Defiant. When you fail a save, succeed instead. Once per long rest (twice at 7th, three times at 9th).
  • Unstoppable. At the start of your turn, end one of: blinded, charmed, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, or stunned. Uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Devastating blows that ignore defenses.

Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal extra damage equal to your Fitness or Insight score (your choice). The damage ignores resistance and immunity and cannot be reduced.

subclasses.name: Spell Blade
subclasses.summary: Blend arcane magic with weapon mastery.

features.name: Arcane Spellcasting
features.summary: Partial Arcane spellcasting (abjuration/evocation focus).
features.descriptionHtml:
Partial Arcane spellcasting (abjuration/evocation focus).

You cast Arcane spells using Insight as your spellcasting ability (save DC 8 + PB + Insight; attack + PB + Insight).

At 2nd level: learn 2 cantrips and 3 1st-level abjuration or evocation spells (one may be from any school). You have 2 1st-level slots, regained on a long rest. Learn additional cantrips and spells at 4th, 6th, and 8th level per the Spell Blade table in the Player's Guide (adapted to YMIAT spell levels).

When Improvement grants a talent, choose from magic or martial lists.

features.name: Enchant Weapon
features.summary: Imbue a weapon (+1, scaling to +3); bonus action summon.
features.descriptionHtml:
Imbue a weapon (+1, scaling to +3); bonus action summon.

After 1 hour of focus on a weapon (during a rest), imbue it as a magic weapon: bonus action to summon to your hand if on the same plane; +1 to attack and damage (stacks with existing magic bonuses). Bonus becomes +2 at 6th level and +3 at 8th. Only one enchanted weapon at a time.

features.name: Spell Multiattack
features.summary: Replace one Multiattack swing with a cantrip.
features.descriptionHtml:
Replace one Multiattack swing with a cantrip.

When you use Multiattack, you can replace one attack with casting a cantrip you know (casting time 1 action). Only one cantrip per Attack action.

features.name: Follow Through
features.summary: Weapon attack after casting a spell.
features.descriptionHtml:
Weapon attack after casting a spell.

When you take the Cast a Spell action, you can make one weapon attack as part of that same action if a target is in range.

features.name: Charged Strike
features.summary: Add Insight to melee damage; weapon damage counts as magical.
features.descriptionHtml:
Add Insight to melee damage; weapon damage counts as magical.

Add your Insight modifier (minimum +1) to melee weapon damage in addition to Fitness or Dexterity. All weapon damage you deal is magical.

subclasses.name: Weapon Master
subclasses.summary: Mastery of chosen weapons and tactical stunts.

features.name: Mastery
features.summary: Master three weapon types; reroll damage or weapon-option damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Master three weapon types; reroll damage or weapon-option damage.

Choose three simple or martial weapon types you have proficiency with. Once per turn when you roll damage with a mastered weapon, reroll the weapon damage dice and use either result. Once per turn with a mastered weapon option, you can roll damage even if the option normally wouldn't.

features.name: Stunts
features.summary: Tactical maneuvers with weapon-specific requirements.
features.descriptionHtml:
Tactical maneuvers with weapon-specific requirements.

Stunt save DC = 8 + PB + Fitness modifier. Uses per short or long rest = PB + 1. One stunt per turn.

  • Arcing Strike (heavy melee): splash half damage to a second target in reach.
  • Cheap Shot (melee): extra unarmed strike on hit during Attack action.
  • Make It Count: single attack at +10; extra damage equal to fighter level.
  • Parry (melee, reaction): reduce damage by 1d10 + PB.
  • Redirect (reaction): reroll missed attack against adjacent target.
  • Riposte (melee, reaction): attack when enemy misses you.
  • Straight Through (ranged): splash half damage to adjacent target.
  • Tactical Retreat (melee): move half speed after hit without opportunity attacks.

features.name: Deadly Flourish
features.summary: 19–20 crits with mastered weapons; reaction attacks on crit.
features.descriptionHtml:
19–20 crits with mastered weapons; reaction attacks on crit.

Attacks with mastered weapons crit on 19–20. On a crit, use your reaction to either: make a ranged attack against up to PB creatures within 15 feet of the target, or make a separate melee attack against each creature within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Advanced Stunts
features.summary: Powerful stunts available whenever you could use a stunt.
features.descriptionHtml:
Powerful stunts available whenever you could use a stunt.

  • Assassin's Ambush: double damage dice from hidden.
  • Bulwark (shield, reaction): reduce spell damage by AC.
  • Felling Sweep (heavy melee, action): one attack roll vs. all in reach.
  • Preemptive Strike (melee, reaction): attack when foe enters reach.
  • Rapid Release (ranged/thrown): bonus attack after Attack action.
  • Wrestler's Clutch (melee): grapple on hit; stunts vs. grappled foe don't cost uses.

features.name: Grand Finale
features.summary: Regain stunt uses when combat begins with none left.
features.descriptionHtml:
Regain stunt uses when combat begins with none left.

When combat begins with no Stunt uses remaining, regain 3 uses. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Scrapper
subclasses.summary: Fighters typically engage with their opponents with manufactured weapons. However, some of them enjoy the physicality of using their bodies as weapons and become

features.name: Grappling Superiority
features.summary: You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. If you are already
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. If you are already

You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. If you are already proficient, double your PB instead for checks made with that skill.

features.name: Mighty Fists
features.summary: Your unarmed attacks become more powerful. When
features.descriptionHtml:
Your unarmed attacks become more powerful. When

Your unarmed attacks become more powerful. When you make an unarmed strike, the damage increases from 1 + your STR modifier to 1d4 + your STR modifier. This further increases to 1d6 at 7th level, 1d8 at 11th level, and 1d10 at 15th level.

features.name: Grappling Maneuvers
features.summary: As a bonus action while grappling a creature, you can
features.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action while grappling a creature, you can

As a free action while grappling a creature, you can perform one of the following grappling maneuvers. You must make a STR (Athletics) check contested by the grappled creature’s STR (Athletics) or DEX (Acrobatics) check (target’s choice). If you succeed, the target is affected by the maneuver until the grapple ends or until you use a different grappling maneuver on it: • Chokehold. You choke a breathing or speaking creature, and it can’t speak or cast spells with verbal components. If the target remains in a chokehold for two consecutive turns, it begins suffocating and continues suffocating until the grapple or this maneuver ends. • Makeshift Shield. You pull the creature between you and danger. You have half cover if the target is your size or smaller and three-quarters cover if it is larger than you. • Pin. You pin, hold, or otherwise immobilize the creature. The target is restrained.

features.name: Expert Grappler
features.summary: You are an expert at holding onto and locking down foes.
features.descriptionHtml:
You are an expert at holding onto and locking down foes.

You are an expert at holding onto and locking down foes.

features.name: Knockout Punch
features.summary: When you hit a creature with two unarmed strikes in
features.descriptionHtml:
When you hit a creature with two unarmed strikes in

When you hit a creature with two unarmed strikes in the same turn (and it has less than half of its Wound maximum) or when you score a critical hit with an unarmed strike, the target must succeed on a CON save (DC 8 + your PB + your STR modifier) or be stunned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

subclasses.name: Stunt Archer
subclasses.summary: Some fighters eschew melee weapons completely, choosing the greater range afforded by bows and crossbows. They become so comfortable with these weapons that they can

features.name: Bow Mastery
features.summary: You have focused your training on ranged weapons,
features.descriptionHtml:
You have focused your training on ranged weapons,

You have focused your training on ranged weapons, specifically bows and crossbows, and gain several bonuses when wielding them. When you make an attack roll with one, you don’t have disadvantage from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, though you can still have disadvantage from other sources.

features.name: Stunt Shots
features.summary: You have developed such familiarity with bows and
features.descriptionHtml:
You have developed such familiarity with bows and

You have developed such familiarity with bows and crossbows that you can use them to make shots considered improbable by others. You gain access to special maneuvers called stunt shots. 1 CLASS OPTIONS 29

features.name: Keen Eye
features.summary: You increase the normal range for any bow or crossbow
features.descriptionHtml:
You increase the normal range for any bow or crossbow

You increase the normal range for any bow or crossbow you wield: • If the normal range is less than 50 feet, it increases by 10 feet. • If the normal range is between 50 and 100 feet, it increases by 20 feet. • If the normal range is greater than 100 feet, it increases by 30 feet.

features.name: Advanced Stunt Shots
features.summary: The following powerful stunt shots are available to you
features.descriptionHtml:
The following powerful stunt shots are available to you

The following powerful stunt shots are available to you whenever you could use a stunt shot. Some advanced stunt shots require you to be wielding a specific type of bow or crossbow to use them.

features.name: Absolute Mastery
features.summary: You treat all bows and crossbows as if they had the
features.descriptionHtml:
You treat all bows and crossbows as if they had the

You treat all bows and crossbows as if they had the

subclasses.name: Twinblade
subclasses.summary: Fighters that choose the Twinblade discipline are master dual-wielders, forgoing cumbersome armaments to become a whirling death that moves through battles with

features.name: Blade Dance
features.summary: As a bonus action, you can begin a blade dance as long
features.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, you can begin a blade dance as long

As a free action, you can begin a blade dance as long as you are neither grappled or restrained nor your speed is otherwise reduced to 0. While engaged in a blade dance, you gain the following benefits if you are wielding a melee weapon in each hand and aren’t wearing medium or heavy armor: • You have advantage on DEX saves and DEX ability checks made to avoid being grappled or restrained or having your movement speed reduced. If you become grappled or restrained, you have advantage on checks made to escape or end the effect as long as your blade dance is active. • Your movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks. • Your speed increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Deadly Grace
features.summary: You gain proficiency in either the Acrobatics or Performance
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain proficiency in either the Acrobatics or Performance

You gain proficiency in either the Acrobatics or Performance skill. If you are already proficient in one or both of these skills, double your PB for checks made with that skill.

features.name: Double Edged
features.summary: When you take the Attack action on your turn and then use
features.descriptionHtml:
When you take the Attack action on your turn and then use

When you take the Attack action on your turn and then use a free action to make one or more additional attacks (such as for two-weapon fighting and the Quick Strike martial action), you can add your DEX modifier to the damage dealt by the bonus attacks. If you have at least one use remaining of your Blade Dance feature, you can activate it as part of the same free action you used to make these attacks.

features.name: One Thousand Cuts
features.summary: When you take the Attack action on your turn while your
features.descriptionHtml:
When you take the Attack action on your turn while your

When you take the Attack action on your turn while your blade dance is active, you can forgo the normal number of attacks granted by your Multiattack to instead make one melee weapon attack that targets each creature within 5 feet of you, using a single attack roll and damage roll.

features.name: Moving Target
features.summary: As long as you aren’t incapacitated, you can’t be grappled or
features.descriptionHtml:
As long as you aren’t incapacitated, you can’t be grappled or

As long as you aren’t incapacitated, you can’t be grappled or restrained, and your speed can’t be reduced by any means.

classes.name: Artificer
classes.summary: An inventor who augments gear and crafts magical items. (BFRD Mechanist.)
classes.proficiencies: Light and medium armor, shields, all weapons, tinker tools + two tools.

abilities.name: Eyes of the Maker
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Identify magic items by touch.

When you touch a magic item, you learn its properties, attunement requirements, charges, active spells, and the spell that created it (if any).

abilities.name: Shard of Creation
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Magical tool with versatile charges.

You craft a Tiny shard of creation (charges = Insight modifier, minimum 1, regained on long rest). Properties include Inspire, Mend, and other BFRD options. The shard vanishes if you die or if apart from you for 24 hours; recreate with a 1-hour ritual.

abilities.name: Augment
abilities.summary: Apply augment effects to carried items.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Apply augment effects to carried items.

You apply augment effects to items you carry. Augment effects known and augmented item limits are on your progression table. See BFRD Mechanist augment list.

abilities.name: Efficient Action
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Augment without wasting effort.

When you use your action to apply an augment effect, you can apply a second effect to a different item as part of the same action.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or utility/martial talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the utility or martial talents list.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Two attacks per Attack action.

Your physical prowess has grown. On your turn, you can make up to two attacks when you take the Attack action.

In YMIAT, each successful weapon attack typically inflicts 1 Wound (2 on a critical hit). Weapon bonuses apply to hit, not to the number of Wounds dealt.

abilities.name: Rapid Augment
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Augment as a free action.

Once per turn, you can apply an augment effect as a free action instead of an action.

abilities.name: Greater Creation
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Craft more potent items.

You can create uncommon magic items using your shard and augment abilities per BFRD Greater Creation rules.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Artificer heroic options per BFRD.

Choose a heroic boon from the BFRD Mechanist list, adapted for YMIAT.

abilities.name: Engineer's Insight
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Flash of mechanical genius.

When you fail an Insight check with a tool you are proficient in, you can reroll and take the higher result. Once per short or long rest.

abilities.name: Ranged Augment
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Apply augments at range.

You can apply augment effects to items you can see within 30 feet.

abilities.name: Always Prepared
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Augments persist through rest.

Augment effects you apply remain until you dismiss them (no action) or apply a new effect to that item.

abilities.name: Perfect Creation
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Master-crafted magical items.

You can create rare magic items per BFRD Perfect Creation rules.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Capstone invention.

Gain the Mechanist Epic Boon from BFRD, adapted for YMIAT.

subclasses.name: Armorer
subclasses.summary: Mystic metal armor and absorbing augments (BFRD Metallurgist).

features.name: Augment: Absorbing
features.summary: Armor/shield absorbs elemental damage and grants resistance.
features.descriptionHtml:
Armor/shield absorbs elemental damage and grants resistance.

Unique augment (doesn't count against known augments): when you take acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, poison, or thunder damage while wearing/wielding the item, use your reaction to reduce damage by 2 × Insight modifier and gain resistance to that type for 1 minute. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Mystic Metal
features.summary: Transmute armor into wearable mystic metal suit.
features.descriptionHtml:
Transmute armor into wearable mystic metal suit.

After 1 hour of focus, transmute a nonmagical suit of armor into mystic metal (AC 13 + Insight modifier; gauntlets 1d6 + FIT or INS; summon as free action within 5 feet). Reverts if another creature dons it.

features.name: Heavy Hitter
features.summary: Extra force damage and improved crit range in mystic metal.
features.descriptionHtml:
Extra force damage and improved crit range in mystic metal.

While wearing mystic metal: weapon attacks deal 1d6 force (1d8 at 5th artificer level, 1d10 at 10th); crit on 19–20.

features.name: Juggernaut
features.summary: Athletics advantage; charge grants attack advantage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Athletics Expertise; charge grants attack advantage.

While in mystic metal: Athletics proficiency (or Expertise / +2×PB if already proficient); advantage on grapple/shove checks; if you move 15+ feet before a melee attack, advantage on that attack.

features.name: Full Metal
features.summary: Brief immunity to physical damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Brief immunity to physical damage.

As a free action, enter Full Metal for 1 minute: immune to B/P/S; resistance to all other damage. Auto-activates at 0 Wounds once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Alchemist
subclasses.summary: Brew volatile concoctions and supportive elixirs.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.summary: Add Insight to alchemist-spell damage and healing.
features.descriptionHtml:
Add Insight to alchemist-spell damage and healing.

When you cast an artificer spell that restores Wounds or deals acid, fire, necrotic, or poison damage, add your Insight modifier to one Wound restoration or damage roll.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.summary: Long-rest elixir for yourself or an ally.
features.descriptionHtml:
Long-rest elixir for yourself or an ally.

When you finish a long rest, create one experimental elixir in a vial. As a bonus action, a creature can drink it (or you can throw it 20 feet; shatter on impact). Roll d6 for the effect:

  • 1–2 Healing: regain 2d4 + Insight Wounds.
  • 3 Swiftness: +10 ft speed for 1 hour.
  • 4 Resilience: +1 AC for 10 minutes.
  • 5 Flight: fly speed 10 ft for 10 minutes.
  • 6 Transformation: alter self for 10 minutes (Insight as spellcasting ability).

Unexpended elixirs lose potency after 24 hours. PB elixirs per long rest at 8th level.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.summary: Free healing when casting certain spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Free healing when casting certain spells.

When you cast an artificer spell of 1st level or higher using a slot, the target (or you if self-targeted) regains Wounds equal to 2d6 + Insight modifier.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.summary: Resistance to acid/poison; greater restoration on demand.
features.descriptionHtml:
Resistance to acid/poison; greater restoration on demand.

You have resistance to acid and poison damage and are immune to the poisoned condition. As an action, touch a creature and end one of: poisoned, paralyzed, or petrified (once per long rest).

subclasses.name: Artillerist
subclasses.summary: Deploy ranged magical ordnance.

features.name: Arcane Grenades
features.summary: Throw force grenades; damage scales 1d8→4d8.
features.descriptionHtml:
Throw force grenades; damage scales 1d8→4d8.

As an action (Use an Object) or by replacing one Attack action attack, throw an arcane grenade (range 20/60, proficient). Use Dexterity or Insight for attack; hit = force damage d8 + Insight (2d8 at 4th, 3d8 at 6th, 4d8 at 8th). One grenade per turn. PB modified grenades per short or long rest (dispersal, flash, kinetic, smoke—see Grenadier rules).

features.name: Augment: Explosive
features.summary: Unique augment: trap objects with force bursts.
features.descriptionHtml:
Unique augment: trap objects with force bursts.

Unique augment (doesn't count against known augments): imbue a Medium or smaller stationary item to explode on your trigger (10-ft sphere, DEX save vs augment DC, (PB+1)d6 force minimum 3d6). PB triggers per long rest.

features.name: Controlled Blasts
features.summary: No close-range disadvantage; protect allies from your ordnance.
features.descriptionHtml:
No close-range disadvantage; protect allies from your ordnance.

No disadvantage on ranged attacks (including grenades) from enemies within 5 feet. When your items or grenades deal damage or impose conditions, choose up to PB allies to be immune. You are immune to your own grenades and augment explosions. Two grenades per turn.

features.name: Superior Firepower
features.summary: Turn misses into hits; extended range; disintegrating crits.
features.descriptionHtml:
Turn misses into hits; extended range; disintegrating crits.

Once per turn when a grenade attack misses, turn it into a hit (Insight modifier uses per long rest). Grenade range 40/80. Crit that drops a foe to 0 Wounds disintegrates it (no magic items). Three grenades per turn.

subclasses.name: Battle Smith
subclasses.summary: Field a steel defender companion.

features.name: Augment: Messenger
features.summary: Augment items with disruptive noise or remote voice.
features.descriptionHtml:
Augment items with disruptive noise or remote voice.

Unique augment: imbue a held/worn item with disruptive noise (WIS save or deafened 1 round; break concentration) or Master's Voice (speak/hear through item 1 minute). PB activations per long rest.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.summary: Insight for magic weapons; steel defender companion.
features.descriptionHtml:
Insight for magic weapons; steel defender companion.

You can use Insight for attack and damage with magic weapons. You gain a steel defender (Medium Construct, PB + Insight AC, Wounds = 5 + five × artificer level). It acts after your turn, obeys commands, and makes force attacks (+ PB to hit, 1d8 + PB force). If reduced to 0 Wounds, revive after a long rest or 1-hour ritual.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.summary: Defender or you jolt a hit for extra force and advantage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Defender or you jolt a hit for extra force and advantage.

When you or your defender hits with a magic weapon, add 2d6 force damage. Once per turn when you cast an artificer spell, the next defender attack before your next turn has advantage.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.summary: Defender gains Multiattack; jolt heals you.
features.descriptionHtml:
Defender gains Multiattack; jolt heals you.

Your steel defender makes two attacks when commanded to Attack. When you use Arcane Jolt, you or the defender regains Wounds equal to half the force damage dealt.

subclasses.name: Cog Augur
subclasses.summary: Some mechanists see the universe and its workings as mathematical calculations. They turn their expertise toward crafting baroque devices to help them read these

features.name: Augment: Clairvoyant
features.summary: Item Requirement: Equipment or Object that Can Fit in One Hand
features.descriptionHtml:
Item Requirement: Equipment or Object that Can Fit in One Hand

Item Requirement: Equipment or Object that Can Fit in One Hand

features.name: Auguring Device
features.summary: You learn to transmute a small device into an augury tool
features.descriptionHtml:
You learn to transmute a small device into an augury tool

You learn to transmute a small device into an augury tool that aids you in calculating and predicting the future. If you spend 1 hour of uninterrupted focus in contact with an object small enough for you to hold in one hand (which can be done as part of a short or long rest), you can transmute that object into an auguring device. The chosen object must be a single object (though that object can have internal moving parts, like a watch or lock) and can’t be a set of tools. The transformation lasts until you choose to end it or until you use this feature to transmute a different object.

features.name: Intricate Predictions
features.summary: You learn to upgrade your Auguring Device feature, which
features.descriptionHtml:
You learn to upgrade your Auguring Device feature, which

You learn to upgrade your Auguring Device feature, which gains the following additional properties: • When you consult the device to learn a detail about a creature, you can now learn two pieces of information from that list. • When you use the weather prediction aspect of the device, you now have advantage on WIS (Survival) checks to predict the weather within the next 7 days. • While holding the device, you can spend 10 minutes communing with the device to learn details about current or future events or to learn the direction to a specific creature or object. These effects work like the divination or locate spells, except the device serves as the material component and isn’t consumed by the spell.

features.name: Improved Divining
features.summary: You learn to adjust your Auguring Device feature’s
features.descriptionHtml:
You learn to adjust your Auguring Device feature’s

You learn to adjust your Auguring Device feature’s calculations to reduce its chances of failure. When you use the augury or divination aspects of the device, the chance of receiving a random answer or no answer, respectively, is a cumulative 10 percent instead of 25 percent. If the device is imbued with the Clairvoyant augment, you can choose for one of the targets to have advantage on all its attack rolls instead of only one.

features.name: Clarity of Vision
features.summary: You can spend 1 minute communing with the device of your
features.descriptionHtml:
You can spend 1 minute communing with the device of your

You can spend 1 minute communing with the device of your

subclasses.name: Grenadier
subclasses.summary: Mechanists who pursue the Grenadier’s craft are disciples of entropy, more interested in how things come apart than how they come together. Grenadiers expertly manipulate

features.name: Arcane Grenades (1d8, 1/turn)
features.summary: You have learned to construct potent magical devices
features.descriptionHtml:
You have learned to construct potent magical devices

You have learned to construct potent magical devices called arcane grenades. As an action (counts as the Use an

subclasses.name: Toymaker
subclasses.summary: Toymakers are mechanists who revel in creating miniature replicas of animals and humans for their own entertainment, to help with various tasks, and to inflict a

features.name: Augment: Messenger
features.summary: You gain the following unique effect for your Augment
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain the following unique effect for your Augment

You gain the following unique effect for your Augment feature. This effect can’t be replaced and doesn’t count against the number of effects that you know, as shown in the Augment Effects Known column of the Mechanist

features.name: Autonomous Toys
features.summary: You design and animate intricate Tiny objects that follow
features.descriptionHtml:
You design and animate intricate Tiny objects that follow

You design and animate intricate Tiny objects that follow your instructions. During a long rest, you can create up to two autonomous toys in the shapes of animals. Each toy is modeled after a Small or smaller Beast (or creature with the

features.name: Automated Power
features.summary: The toys from your Autonomous Toys feature gain a bonus
features.descriptionHtml:
The toys from your Autonomous Toys feature gain a bonus

The toys from your Autonomous Toys feature gain a bonus to their saves and to their ACs equal to your PB, and when one of your toys is destroyed while within 30 feet of you, you become empowered until the end of your next turn. While empowered, you have advantage on attack rolls and saves.

features.name: Eyes Everywhere
features.summary: While you are within 10 feet of at least two of the toys from
features.descriptionHtml:
While you are within 10 feet of at least two of the toys from

While you are within 10 feet of at least two of the toys from your Autonomous Toys feature, you have advantage on

features.name: Ultimate Toymaker
features.summary: Your maximum number of augmented items (see Augment
features.descriptionHtml:
Your maximum number of augmented items (see Augment

Your maximum number of augmented items (see Augment feature in Player’s Guide) increases by 3, but these extra augments must be on toys from your Autonomous Toys feature. A toy can have up to two augments on it at one time. As normal, multiple instances of one augment aren’t cumulative on the toy.

classes.name: Monk
classes.summary: A martial artist channeling technique points for supernatural strikes and mobility.

abilities.name: Martial Arts
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Unarmed strikes and monk weapons.

While unarmed or wielding only monk weapons without armor or shield:

  • Your unarmed strikes use the Martial Arts die from your progression table.
  • You use Fitness for attack and damage with unarmed strikes and monk weapons.
  • When you take the Attack action with an unarmed strike or monk weapon, you can make one unarmed strike as your second action if you have not moved (at disadvantage if it is an attack).

abilities.name: Unarmored Defense
abilities.descriptionHtml:
AC from agility and insight.

While unarmored and without a shield, AC = 10 + Fitness modifier + Insight modifier.

abilities.name: Techniques
abilities.summary: Spend technique points on supernatural maneuvers.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Spend technique points on supernatural maneuvers.

Technique points per progression table, regained on short or long rest (30 min meditation). Options include Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, and more. Save DC = 8 + PB + Insight modifier.

abilities.name: Unarmored Movement
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Supernatural speed without armor.

Your speed increases while unarmored per the Movement column on your progression table.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a martial talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a martial talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the martial talents list.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Two attacks per Attack action.

Your physical prowess has grown. On your turn, you can make up to two attacks when you take the Attack action.

In YMIAT, each successful weapon attack typically inflicts 1 Wound (2 on a critical hit). Weapon bonuses apply to hit, not to the number of Wounds dealt.

abilities.name: Stunning Strike
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Stun foes with ki-infused blows.

Once per turn when you hit with an unarmed strike or monk weapon, spend 1 technique point to force a Fitness save. On a failure, the target is stunned until the end of your next turn.

abilities.name: Empowered Strikes
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Unarmed strikes count as magical.

Your unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Dodge area effects.

When you make a Fitness save for half damage from an area effect, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Purity of Body or Mind.

Choose Purity of Body (immune to disease/poison) or Purity of Mind (advantage on Insight saves; end charm/fear as free action).

abilities.name: Perfect Motion
abilities.summary: Run on walls and fall safely.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Run on walls and fall safely.

Reduce falling damage by 5 × monk level as a reaction. Move along vertical surfaces and liquids without falling during the move.

abilities.name: Astral Teachings
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Temporarily master any skill.

Spend 2 technique points to gain proficiency in one language, skill, tool, or weapon until incapacitated or you use this again.

abilities.name: Diamond Soul
abilities.summary: Proficiency in all saves; reroll failures.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Proficiency in all saves; reroll failures.

Proficiency in all saves. When you fail a save, spend 1 technique point to reroll (must take the new result).

abilities.name: Timeless Self
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Sustained by inner energy.

Cannot be magically aged; no food or water needed; ability modifiers and Max Wounds cannot be lowered except by wish.

abilities.name: Empty Body
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Invisibility and astral travel.

Spend 4 technique points to become invisible for 1 minute with resistance to all damage except force. Or spend 8 points to cast astral projection as an action.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Technique points refill when combat begins.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Technique points refill when combat begins.

When combat begins, regain up to 4 technique points. If you start a turn with 0 points, regain 2.

subclasses.name: Flickering Dark
subclasses.summary: Harness shadow energy between strikes.

features.name: Dark Flame
features.summary: Bonus action shadow aura: clawing, grasp, or spreading darkness.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus action shadow aura: clawing, grasp, or spreading darkness.

As a free action, spend 2 technique points for a 10-foot-radius magical darkness (moves with you, 1 minute, not dispelled by spells of 5th level or lower). Choose one property:

  • Clawing Shadows: creatures entering or starting turn inside take necrotic = martial arts die; you regain Wounds equal to necrotic dealt (Constructs/Undead unaffected).
  • Grasp of Nothingness: unarmed strikes deal extra necrotic = PB.
  • Spreading Darkness: action + 1 technique point to cast darkness without a slot.

At 6th level, choose two properties instead of one.

features.name: Obsidian Eyes
features.summary: Grant darkvision through magical darkness; upgrades at 4th/6th.
features.descriptionHtml:
Grant darkvision through magical darkness; upgrades at 4th/6th.

After 1 minute of meditation (during a rest), grant a willing creature obsidian eyes until their next long rest: see in dim light, darkness, and magical darkness as bright light (60 ft). At 4th monk level they see invisible creatures; at 6th they can't be blinded.

features.name: Grace of Umbra
features.summary: Step of the Wind grants intangibility and shadow teleport.
features.descriptionHtml:
Step of the Wind grants intangibility and shadow teleport.

When you use Step of the Wind, you become insubstantial until end of next turn—outside sunlight you and your gear can move through narrow openings. Spend +1 technique point to teleport up to your speed to dim light, darkness, or magical darkness you can see. At 8th level, resistance to all damage except radiant while active.

features.name: Feeding Dark
features.summary: Weaken attackers in your magical darkness; long-range shadow step.
features.descriptionHtml:
Weaken attackers in your magical darkness; long-range shadow step.

Creatures starting turn in your magical darkness make a Fitness save or deal half damage with Fitness/Dexterity weapon attacks until end of turn. When a creature saves or fails, use a reaction to teleport up to 1 mile adjacent to it (once per long rest, or 3 technique points).

features.name: Strike of Searing Shadow
features.summary: Reaction finisher that pulls foes toward a dying enemy.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reaction finisher that pulls foes toward a dying enemy.

When you hit with a melee attack, use a reaction and spend 5 technique points. Target makes Fitness save: 3d10 fire + 3d10 necrotic (half on success). Creatures you choose within 30 feet make Fitness save vs technique DC or take 2d10 force and are pulled 20 feet toward the target. Reducing a creature to 0 Wounds with this leaves its shadow permanently on the surface; you gain temp Wounds = half its Max Wounds.

subclasses.name: Open Hand
subclasses.summary: Push, trip, and shatter foes with perfected technique.

features.name: Focus Intent
features.summary: Reaction: add martial arts die to ally or enemy roll.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reaction: add martial arts die to ally or enemy roll.

When you or a creature within 5 feet makes an ability check or attack roll, use your reaction to roll your martial arts die and add or subtract it from the roll. Uses = Insight modifier per long rest.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.summary: Flurry of Blows imposes knockdown, push, or no reactions.
features.descriptionHtml:
Flurry of Blows imposes knockdown, push, or no reactions.

When you hit with a Flurry of Blows attack, impose one effect: target can't take reactions until your next turn; Insight save or knocked prone; Fitness save or pushed 15 feet.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.summary: Heal when combat begins.
features.descriptionHtml:
Heal when combat begins.

When combat begins with at least 1 Wound remaining, regain Wounds equal to Fitness modifier + monk level.

features.name: Tranquil Soul
features.summary: Long-duration sanctuary via technique points.
features.descriptionHtml:
Long-duration sanctuary via technique points.

As an action, spend 3 technique points to cast sanctuary on yourself until your next short or long rest (or until it ends normally).

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.summary: Store lethal vibrations in a struck foe.
features.descriptionHtml:
Store lethal vibrations in a struck foe.

As an action, make one unarmed strike. On a hit, spend 4 technique points to store vibrations for days equal to monk level. Later, use an action to end them: target makes Fitness save or takes force damage equal to 5 × monk level and is paralyzed; failure by 5+ is instant death. Cost increases by 2 per additional use until long rest.

subclasses.name: Affliction Eater
subclasses.summary: Some monks realize the careful balance between life and death, and they’ve honed their bodies and minds to ensure the balance tips in their favor. However, they

features.name: Absorb Affliction
features.summary: As a bonus action, you can touch a creature within 5 feet of
features.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, you can touch a creature within 5 feet of

As a free action, you can touch a creature within 5 feet of you and heal it at a cost to you. The target regains a number of Wounds up to your CON modifier + your monk level or loses a condition affecting it. In exchange, you take damage equal to the Wounds the target regained, or you gain the condition you removed from the target. If the condition allowed a save and has a duration of 1 minute or less, you can make that save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success, even if the effect allowed no repeat saves. If the condition has a longer duration, you can make the save every hour.

features.name: Stay Execution
features.summary: When a creature within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 HP,
features.descriptionHtml:
When a creature within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 HP,

When a creature within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 HP, you can spend 2 technique points to stay its death. The target is unconscious but stable, or you can choose for it to regain Wounds equal to one roll of your martial arts die + your WIS modifier and become conscious. If the target was hostile toward you before it was reduced to 0 HP, you have advantage on CHA checks to interact with it for the next 24 hours, as it understands you spared its life.

features.name: Intercedence
features.summary: You grant good fortune to your ally at the cost of your own.
features.descriptionHtml:
You grant good fortune to your ally at the cost of your own.

You grant good fortune to your ally at the cost of your own.

features.name: Shield from Harm
features.summary: You link yourself to another creature, reducing harm to
features.descriptionHtml:
You link yourself to another creature, reducing harm to

You link yourself to another creature, reducing harm to it as you channel some of its wounds to yourself. As an action, you can spend 3 technique points to cast the warding bond spell on a friendly creature, without requiring a material component.

features.name: Merciful Burst
features.summary: As a bonus action, you can reduce your current hit points
features.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, you can reduce your current hit points

As a free action, you can reduce your current Wounds by 40, reducing your Max Wounds by the same amount, to release a burst of healing energy in a 60-foot radius centered on you. If you spend 11 technique points when activating this feature, you don’t reduce your hit points or Max Wounds. Each creature you choose within the area regains a number of Wounds equal to your

subclasses.name: Elemental Voice
subclasses.summary: Monks that pursue the way of the Elemental Voice seek to reshape the primordial world around them with their will. These monks often share similarities in manner or dress

features.name: Elemental Voice Feature
features.summary: Elemental Voice subclass feature from ToV Player's Guide 2.
features.descriptionHtml:
Elemental Voice subclass feature from ToV Player's Guide 2.

Elemental Voice subclass features from Tales of the Valiant Player's Guide 2. Apply using YMIAT terminology (Wounds, Fitness/Insight/Willpower, spell levels).

subclasses.name: Seal Guardian
subclasses.summary: Seal Guardian monks apply the knowledge they gain from transcribing written works to the creation of magical seals, which they can offer to others for protection or to drive out

features.name: Seal Guardian Feature
features.summary: Seal Guardian subclass feature from ToV Player's Guide 2.
features.descriptionHtml:
Seal Guardian subclass feature from ToV Player's Guide 2.

Seal Guardian subclass features from Tales of the Valiant Player's Guide 2. Apply using YMIAT terminology (Wounds, Fitness/Insight/Willpower, spell levels).

classes.name: Paladin
classes.summary: A holy warrior combining martial prowess with divine spells and smites.
classes.proficiencies: All armor, shields, simple and martial weapons.
classes.spellcasting: Divine spells known (half caster). Oath spells always known.

abilities.name: Divine Sense
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Detect celestials, fiends, and undead.

On your turn, detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 feet (not behind total cover) and consecrated/desecrated sites. Uses = proficiency bonus + 1 per long rest.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Pool of healing touch.

Pool = 5 × paladin level, restored on long rest. As an action, touch a creature and heal Wounds from the pool. Spend 5 healing to cure one disease or poison.

abilities.name: Divine Smite
abilities.summary: Spend Spell Power for radiant burst on hit.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Spend Spell Power for radiant burst on hit.

Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, spend Spell Power to deal extra radiant damage: 2d8 for 1st level + 1d8 per higher level (max 5d8). +1d8 vs Fiends and Undead.

abilities.name: Martial Action
abilities.summary: Guard or Wind Up as second action.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Guard or Wind Up as second action.

Choose Guard or Wind Up. Use as your second action when you have not moved this turn (see Martial Action).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Divine spells known (half caster).

As a conduit for Divine magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Paladin progression table.

You know a fixed list of spells and do not prepare them daily. Learn additional spells at the levels shown on your class progression table.

Spellcasting ability: Willpower (WIL). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Willpower (WIL) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a martial talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a martial talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the martial talents list.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Two attacks per Attack action.

Your physical prowess has grown. On your turn, you can make up to two attacks when you take the Attack action.

In YMIAT, each successful weapon attack typically inflicts 1 Wound (2 on a critical hit). Weapon bonuses apply to hit, not to the number of Wounds dealt.

abilities.name: Aura of Protection
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Bolster allies' saves.

When you or a friendly creature within 10 feet makes a save, they add your Willpower modifier (minimum +1). You must be conscious.

abilities.name: Aura of Courage
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Allies cannot be frightened.

You and friendly creatures within 10 feet cannot be frightened while you are conscious.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Divine Recovery or Radiant Strikes.

Divine Recovery (Lay on Hands lets target expend a Recovery die) or Radiant Strikes (+1d8 radiant on weapon hits, 2d8 vs Fiends/Undead).

abilities.name: Channel Divinity
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Oath-specific channel divinity.

Your oath grants Channel Divinity options. Uses: 1/rest until 6th level, then 2/rest, then 3/rest at 9th. Regain on short or long rest.

abilities.name: Cleansing Touch
abilities.summary: End spells on yourself or allies.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
End spells on yourself or allies.

Action to end one spell on yourself or a willing creature you touch. Uses = Willpower modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Aura Improvements
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Aura range increases to 30 feet.

Aura of Protection, Aura of Courage, and oath auras extend to 30 feet.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Calming aura of salvation.

Action: 1-hour aura (30 ft). Allies resist nonmagical damage, auto-succeed Life Saves, and regain Willpower modifier Wounds at start of turn if they have any Wounds remaining. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Devotion
subclasses.summary: Oath-bound knight of duty, honor, and righteous order.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.summary: Empower a held weapon with radiant light.
features.descriptionHtml:
Empower a held weapon with radiant light.

As an action, imbue a held weapon for 1 minute: add Willpower modifier to attack rolls (min +1); bright light 20 ft. Weapon becomes magical for the duration.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sanctifying Light
features.summary: Blind aberrations, fey, fiends, and undead.
features.descriptionHtml:
Blind aberrations, fey, fiends, and undead.

As an action, each Aberration, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet that can see you makes a Willpower save or is blinded for 1 minute (Fitness save ends on self each turn).

features.name: Devotion Oath Spells
features.summary: Always-known oath spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known oath spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: sanctuary
  • Level 5: warding bond
  • Level 7: protection from energy
  • Level 9: stoneskin
  • Level 10: mass cure wounds

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.summary: Allies near you can't be charmed.
features.descriptionHtml:
Allies near you can't be charmed.

You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be charmed while you are conscious (30 feet at 8th paladin level via Aura Improvements).

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.summary: Protection from supernatural creatures.
features.descriptionHtml:
Protection from supernatural creatures.

Against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Undead, and Outsiders: they have disadvantage attacking you; you can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed; Divine Sense detects all listed types.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.summary: Radiant sunlight aura damages enemies.
features.descriptionHtml:
Radiant sunlight aura damages enemies.

As an action, emit sunlight (30 ft bright / 30 ft dim) for 1 minute. Enemies starting turn in bright light take radiant damage equal to paladin level. You have advantage on saves. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Justice
subclasses.summary: Paladin of law who punishes the guilty without mercy.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Burden of Guilt
features.summary: Curse a foe with halved speed and grounded flight.
features.descriptionHtml:
Curse a foe with halved speed and grounded flight.

As a free action, curse one foe you can see within 30 feet for 1 minute: speed halved; if flying at end of turn, Willpower save or fall. Ends if you fall unconscious.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Judgement
features.summary: Mark a quarry for advantage and radiant damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Mark a quarry for advantage and radiant damage.

As a free action, mark one target within 10 feet for 1 minute: advantage on attacks against it; weapon hits deal extra radiant = Willpower modifier. Ends if you damage another creature.

features.name: Justice Oath Spells
features.summary: Always-known justice oath spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known justice oath spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: pendulum
  • Level 5: misty step
  • Level 9: haste
  • Level 10: greater invisibility

features.name: Aura of Vigilance
features.summary: Allies near you reposition when combat begins.
features.descriptionHtml:
Allies near you reposition when combat begins.

When combat begins, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet (30 feet at 8th paladin level) can each move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks before the first turn. You must not be incapacitated.

features.name: Unworthy Adversary
features.summary: Reaction intercept: move toward attacker and strike judged quarry.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reaction intercept: move toward attacker and strike judged quarry.

When a creature within 30 feet attacks an ally, use your reaction to move up to half your speed toward the attacker. If the attacker is your Judgement target, make a weapon attack as part of the same reaction.

features.name: Divine Executioner
features.summary: Hour-long avatar of decisive justice.
features.descriptionHtml:
Hour-long avatar of decisive justice.

As an action, channel order for 1 hour (once per long rest): reroll any damage you deal (must use new result); one extra attack when you take the Attack action; reaction when an enemy within 10 feet damages you or an ally forces that enemy to take half the damage dealt (same type).

subclasses.name: Anathema
subclasses.summary: Paladins wishing to end immediate threats posed by evil creatures and who don’t mind the stains of close dealings with such creatures swear an oath of Anathema. These

features.summary: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the

You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the

subclasses.summary: Swearing an oath of Safekeeping binds a paladin to a person, place, or object, which they steadfastly guard. These paladins might change the subjects of their protection, but

features.name: Channel
features.summary: Death Domain Spells, Death’s Sentinel
features.descriptionHtml:
Death Domain Spells, Death’s Sentinel

Death Domain Spells, Death’s Sentinel 7th

features.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Blockade
features.summary: As a bonus action, you can ward an object or space, no
features.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, you can ward an object or space, no

As a free action, you can ward an object or space, no larger than 5 feet on a side, from a single target creature you can see within 30 feet. For 1 minute, the target’s speed is halved when trying to move toward the object or space.

subclasses.name: Unbound
subclasses.summary: Paladins who have witnessed duplicity in their leaders or that feel taken advantage of often swear an oath of the Unbound. They saw their leaders’ corruption and blasé

features.name: Channel Divinity: Forceful Unyoking
features.summary: As an action, you can present your holy symbol and utter
features.descriptionHtml:
As an action, you can present your holy symbol and utter

As an action, you can present your holy symbol and utter a rebuke in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area that is charmed, grappled, or restrained by another creature is immediately freed and has advantage on checks and saves against these conditions for 1 minute. Each creature within 30 feet of you that caused a creature in the cone to suffer one of the removed conditions takes psychic damage equal to twice your CHA modifier (minimum of 1).

classes.name: Ranger
classes.summary: A wilderness hunter marked by mystic quarry and primordial magic.
classes.proficiencies: Light and medium armor, shields, all weapons; herbalist, navigator, or trapper tools.

abilities.name: Explorer
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Unmatched wilderness mobility.

Climbing or swimming speed equal to walking speed. Advantage on tracking checks. Speed not halved in difficult terrain (other penalties still apply).

abilities.name: Mystic Mark
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Mark quarry for extra damage.

When you hit a creature, mark it for 1 minute (extra damage d4 → d6 at 3rd → d8 at 6th → d10 at 9th). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

abilities.name: Martial Action
abilities.summary: Aim or Quick Strike as second action.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Aim or Quick Strike as second action.

Choose Aim or Quick Strike. Second action when you have not moved (see Martial Action).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Primordial spells known.

As a conduit for Primordial magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Ranger progression table.

You know a fixed list of spells and do not prepare them daily. Learn additional spells at the levels shown on your class progression table.

Spellcasting ability: Insight (INS). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Insight (INS) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or martial/utility talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the martial or utility talents list.
