Two attacks per Attack action.

Your physical prowess has grown. On your turn, you can make up to two attacks when you take the Attack action.

In YMIAT, each successful weapon attack typically inflicts 1 Wound (2 on a critical hit). Weapon bonuses apply to hit, not to the number of Wounds dealt.

abilities.name: Empowered Mark
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Sense and strike your quarry.

While your mark is within 60 feet, you know its location and it cannot gain advantage from being unseen. No disadvantage from invisibility when attacking it.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Path of the Predator or Sage.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Path of the Predator or Sage.

Predator: Mark your quarry when combat begins without needing to hit first; transfer mark when quarry dies. Sage: Learn two extra cantrips and two Primordial rituals.

abilities.name: Stalker's Step
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Vanish in natural cover.

In dim light, darkness, or natural obscurement, use an action to become invisible until your next turn (ends if you attack or cast). Uses = PB per long rest.

abilities.name: Keensense
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Hearing-based blindsight.

Keensense 10 feet (does not work while deafened).

abilities.name: Strider
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Move without provoking opportunity attacks.

Your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Advantage on saves vs grapple, restraint, paralysis, and speed reduction.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Wisdom guides every blow against your mark.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Wisdom guides every blow against your mark.

Add your Insight modifier to the attack or damage roll of each attack against a mystic-marked creature on your turn.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.summary: Slayer of supernatural predators threatening the wilds.

features.name: Hunter Calling Spells
features.summary: Always-known hunter spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known hunter spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: protection from evil and good
  • Level 5: misty step
  • Level 9: nondetection
  • Level 10: banishment

features.name: Killer Instinct
features.summary: Learn target resistances and vulnerabilities.
features.descriptionHtml:
Learn target resistances and vulnerabilities.

As a free action, learn a creature's immunities, resistances, and vulnerabilities within 60 feet (blocked by anti-divination). PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.summary: Extra damage vs. wounded quarry.
features.descriptionHtml:
Extra damage vs. wounded quarry.

Once per turn when you hit a creature below Max Wounds, deal extra damage equal to your Mystic Mark die (same damage type).

features.name: Favored Foe
features.summary: Prepare against a creature type after research.
features.descriptionHtml:
Prepare against a creature type after research.

During a long rest, choose a creature type (Aberration, Beast, Celestial, etc.). For 24 hours, that type has disadvantage attacking you and you have advantage on saves vs. their charm, frighten, or possession.

features.name: No Escape
features.summary: Teleport to marked prey that tries to flee.
features.descriptionHtml:
Teleport to marked prey that tries to flee.

When a creature marked by Mystic Mark moves, use your reaction to teleport up to 30 feet. If you end within reach, make an opportunity attack as part of the same reaction.

features.name: Predator's Shield
features.summary: Resistance to damage from a seen attacker.
features.descriptionHtml:
Resistance to damage from a seen attacker.

When you take damage from a creature you can see, use your reaction to gain resistance to all damage from that creature for 1 minute (including the triggering hit). Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Pack Master
subclasses.summary: Lead beast companions and coordinated pack tactics.

features.name: Beast Spirit
features.summary: Ritual-bound beast spirit companion (avian, agile, aquatic, or sturdy).
features.descriptionHtml:
Ritual-bound beast spirit companion (avian, agile, aquatic, or sturdy).

After a 1-hour ritual (during a rest), bind a beast spirit in a Medium animal form (avian/agile/aquatic/sturdy). It is friendly, shares your initiative (acts after you), and uses your PB in its statistics. Natural weapon: +4 + PB to hit, 1d8 + 4 + PB damage (B/P/S your choice). Multiattack count = half PB (rounded down). At 0 Wounds the body is destroyed; repeat ritual to recreate. See Pack Master stat block in Player's Guide.

features.name: Life Link
features.summary: Reaction: take your companion's damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reaction: take your companion's damage.

When your beast spirit takes damage within 30 feet, use your reaction to take any amount of that damage instead (not reduced by your resistances). PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Pack Master Calling Spells
features.summary: Always-known pack master calling spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known pack master calling spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: animal friendship
  • Level 5: wildsense
  • Level 9: spirit guardians
  • Level 10: polymorph

features.name: Shared Mark
features.summary: Companion attacks are magical; extra damage vs Mystic Mark.
features.descriptionHtml:
Companion attacks are magical; extra damage vs Mystic Mark.

Your beast spirit's attacks count as magical. While a creature bears your Mystic Mark, the spirit's hits deal extra damage equal to your Mystic Mark die (scales with ranger level).

features.name: Soul Bond
features.summary: Share spell targeting and delivery with your spirit.
features.descriptionHtml:
Share spell targeting and delivery with your spirit.

When you are targeted by a spell, your spirit within 30 feet can be targeted too and receives the same benefits. When you cast a non-self spell, your spirit within 100 feet can use its reaction to deliver it using your spellcasting modifier and DC.

features.name: Undying Friendship
features.summary: Spirit sacrifice restores you at 0 Wounds.
features.descriptionHtml:
Spirit sacrifice restores you at 0 Wounds.

At 0 Wounds or instant death while your spirit is active, it can sacrifice itself: its body is destroyed and you return with Wounds equal to those it had. Requires a long rest before you can perform the binding ritual again.

subclasses.summary: Arrow binders are rangers who have melded their mastery of the wilds with their mastery of the bow. They channel primordial magic into their ammunition, unleashing spell

features.summary: You gain calling spells at the ranger levels listed in the
features.descriptionHtml:

You gain calling spells at the ranger levels listed in the

features.summary: As an action, you can expend a spell slot to cast a
features.descriptionHtml:

As an action, you can expend a spell level to cast a

subclasses.name: Shadow
subclasses.summary: The Shadow’s calling is a rare one, often drawing in rangers who have lost much to the world’s monsters. Such rangers draw on the gloom of night and the dark of sunless caves

features.name: Night’s Gaze
features.summary: Your attunement to the dark corners of the world sharpens
features.descriptionHtml:
Your attunement to the dark corners of the world sharpens

Your attunement to the dark corners of the world sharpens your senses. You gain darkvision to a range of 60 feet, if you don’t already have it, and can see in magical darkness as if it was normal darkness. You have advantage on DEX (Stealth) checks made while in magical darkness.

features.name: Predator’s Strike
features.summary: You have advantage on attack rolls against surprised
features.descriptionHtml:
You have advantage on attack rolls against surprised

You have advantage on attack rolls against surprised creatures. Once on your turn, when you make a weapon attack that hits a creature that can’t see you or that has no allies within 5 feet of it, you deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage is equal to the amount your

subclasses.name: Trailblazer
subclasses.summary: Trailblazers lead expeditions into the unknown and guard travelers through the most dangerous wilds. They are unparalleled experts of the natural world, navigating

features.name: Expert Guide
features.summary: You gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills. If
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills. If

You gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills. If you are already proficient in one or both of these skills, double your PB instead for checks made with that skill.

features.name: Focus Fire
features.summary: When you mark a creature with your Mystic Mark feature
features.descriptionHtml:
When you mark a creature with your Mystic Mark feature

When you mark a creature with your Mystic Mark feature (see Player’s Guide), you can share some of its power with an ally. Choose one friendly creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you. While the mark lasts, the chosen ally deals extra damage of their weapon’s type equal to your Mystic

features.name: Trailblazer
features.summary: You gain calling spells at the ranger levels listed in the
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain calling spells at the ranger levels listed in the

You gain calling spells at the ranger levels listed in the

classes.name: Rogue
classes.summary: A skilled infiltrator delivering precision Sneak Attack damage.
classes.proficiencies: Light armor; simple and martial finesse weapons; thieves' tools; four skills.

abilities.name: Expertise
abilities.descriptionHtml:
+2×PB on chosen skill checks.

Choose two proficiencies (four at 4th level). You have Expertise with them: add +2×PB instead of +PB on related ability checks.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.summary: Extra precision damage once per turn.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Extra precision damage once per turn.

Once per turn, deal extra Sneak Attack dice when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage, or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target. Damage per Sneak Attack column.

abilities.name: Thieves' Cant
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Secret criminal dialect.

You know Thieves' Cant for hidden messages and recognize criminal signs.

abilities.name: Cunning Action
abilities.summary: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a free action.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a free action.

On your turn, use a free action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a utility talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a utility talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the utility talents list.

abilities.name: Uncanny Dodge
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Halve damage from one attack.

When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the Wounds from that attack.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.summary: Negate area damage on successful saves.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Negate area damage on successful saves.

On successful Fitness saves vs area effects, take no damage; half on failure.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Escape Artist or Jack of All Trades.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Escape Artist or Jack of All Trades.

Escape Artist: area saves deal no damage on success. Jack of All Trades: pick talents from any list; gain one immediately.

abilities.name: Reliable Talent
abilities.summary: Treat low rolls as 10 on proficient checks.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Treat low rolls as 10 on proficient checks.

Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on ability checks with skills or tools you are proficient in.

abilities.name: Precise Critical
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Critical hits on 19–20 with finesse/ranged.

Critical hit on 19–20 with finesse or ranged weapons. Roll 1 extra weapon die on crit at 6th level, 2 extra at 8th.

abilities.name: Keensense
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Hearing-based blindsight 10 feet.

Keensense 10 feet unless deafened.

abilities.name: Elusive
abilities.summary: Attackers rarely have advantage against you.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Attackers rarely have advantage against you.

While not incapacitated, attack rolls cannot have advantage against you.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Turn failure into success.

Turn a missed attack into a hit, or treat a failed ability check d20 as 20. Once per short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Enforcer
subclasses.summary: Intimidation, control, and ruthless precision.

features.name: Ambush
features.summary: First-round advantage; auto-crit vs surprised foes.
features.descriptionHtml:
First-round advantage; auto-crit vs surprised foes.

During the first round of combat, you have advantage on the first attack roll you make against each creature in the combat. Attacks against surprised creatures are automatic critical hits.

features.name: Cold-Blooded
features.summary: Bonus attack when you drop a foe.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus attack when you drop a foe.

Once per turn when you reduce a creature to 0 Wounds with a weapon attack, immediately make one additional weapon attack against a different creature within range (no Sneak Attack on this bonus attack).

features.name: Expanded Talent List
features.summary: Martial or utility talents on Improvement.
features.descriptionHtml:
Martial or utility talents on Improvement.

When you gain a talent from Improvement, choose from the martial or utility talent lists.

features.name: Brawler
features.summary: Sneak Attack in melee without ally adjacency; unarmed eligible.
features.descriptionHtml:
Sneak Attack in melee without ally adjacency; unarmed eligible.

Sneak Attack works against a target within 5 feet even if no other creatures are adjacent—you don't need advantage but can't have disadvantage. Sneak Attack applies to unarmed strikes.

features.name: Ready to Rumble
features.summary: Can't be surprised; first-turn edge when combat begins.
features.descriptionHtml:
Can't be surprised; first-turn edge when combat begins.

While not incapacitated, you can't be surprised. When combat begins and you aren't surprised, you have advantage on the first attack roll you make on your first turn.

features.name: Kill Shot
features.summary: Reroll Sneak Attack dice; Sneak Attack on opportunity attacks.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reroll Sneak Attack dice; Sneak Attack on opportunity attacks.

When you roll Sneak Attack damage, reroll any dice (must use new results). You can apply Sneak Attack to an eligible opportunity attack if you haven't used Sneak Attack this round.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.summary: Climb, appraise, and strike before foes react.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.summary: Cunning Action can sleight of hand, use object, or pick locks.
features.descriptionHtml:
Cunning Action can sleight of hand, use object, or pick locks.

Your Cunning Action free action can also: Sleight of Hand; Use an Object; or use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.summary: Climbing speed and improved jumps.
features.descriptionHtml:
Climbing speed and improved jumps.

Climbing speed equals walking speed (+10 ft if you already had climbing speed). Long jump uses walking speed with 10 ft run-up; standing long jump half speed. May use Acrobatics instead of Athletics for jump checks.

features.name: Appraising Eye
features.summary: Identify value and magic of objects.
features.descriptionHtml:
Identify value and magic of objects.

Action to inspect an object within 10 feet: learn if nonmagical (and value) or magical (1 minute study reveals type, rarity, curse, attunement; can ignore class requirements after study).

features.name: Trap Specialist
features.summary: Reaction disarm traps including magical ones.
features.descriptionHtml:
Reaction disarm traps including magical ones.

When you or an ally within 5 feet triggers a trap, reaction to disarm it. Magical traps: ability check using Fitness modifier vs. trap DC.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.summary: Two turns in the first round of combat.
features.descriptionHtml:
Two turns in the first round of combat.

When combat begins and you are not surprised, on your first turn you may take a second action as if you had moved 0 feet, without the usual penalties for a second action. You can't use this feature if you are surprised.

subclasses.name: Con Arcanist
subclasses.summary: You add magic to your bag of tricks to confound your foes or relieve others of their possessions. Your spellcasting allows you to perform more dangerous stunts from a distance.

features.name: Con Arcanist Feature
features.summary: Con Arcanist subclass feature from ToV Player's Guide 2.
features.descriptionHtml:
Con Arcanist subclass feature from ToV Player's Guide 2.

Con Arcanist subclass features from Tales of the Valiant Player's Guide 2. Apply using YMIAT terminology (Wounds, Fitness/Insight/Willpower, spell levels).

features.name: Psychic Blade
features.summary: You manifest a portion of your soul into psychic blades.
features.descriptionHtml:
You manifest a portion of your soul into psychic blades.

You manifest a portion of your soul into psychic blades.

features.name: Psychic Bulwark
features.summary: You have spent time honing the power of your mind. You
features.descriptionHtml:
You have spent time honing the power of your mind. You

You have spent time honing the power of your mind. You are resistant to psychic damage.

features.name: Enhanced Blades (+1)
features.summary: Your psychic blade becomes magical, and you gain a +1
features.descriptionHtml:
Your psychic blade becomes magical, and you gain a +1

Your psychic blade becomes magical, and you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it.

features.summary: Your psychic blades now act as beacons. The range of your
features.descriptionHtml:

Your psychic blades now act as beacons. The range of your

subclasses.summary: Some rogues focus all their attention on understanding traps. This fixation makes them better at avoiding dangers and keeping their companions safe. Trapsmith rogues also

features.name: Makeshift Trap
features.summary: You can spend 1 minute crafting a simple, makeshift trap,
features.descriptionHtml:
You can spend 1 minute crafting a simple, makeshift trap,

You can spend 1 minute crafting a simple, makeshift trap, using the materials at hand. The trap is a Small or smaller object with an AC of 10 + your PB and Wounds equal to twice your rogue level. You can place the trap as an action,

features.name: Trap Expertise
features.summary: You have advantage on checks to find or notice traps,
features.descriptionHtml:
You have advantage on checks to find or notice traps,

You have advantage on checks to find or notice traps, checks to determine how traps work, and checks to disarm or disable traps with thieves’ tools. If you don’t have thieves’ tools, you can attempt to disarm or disable a trap with the materials at hand, but you have disadvantage on the check.

features.name: Rework Trap
features.summary: When you disarm a trap you didn’t make or set, you can
features.descriptionHtml:
When you disarm a trap you didn’t make or set, you can

When you disarm a trap you didn’t make or set, you can leave the trap untriggered and change the DC to disable it to your trap save DC. You can also add effects from the

features.name: Improved Traps
features.summary: You can now create a trap as an action and set it as a bonus
features.descriptionHtml:
You can now create a trap as an action and set it as a bonus

You can now create a trap as an action and set it as a bonus action. When you set a trap you created, it can now be in any unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you, and the distance at which you can remotely trigger a trap with the Rework Trap feature increases to 60 feet.

features.name: Trap Mastery
features.summary: When you fail to disarm a trap that automatically triggers
features.descriptionHtml:
When you fail to disarm a trap that automatically triggers

When you fail to disarm a trap that automatically triggers when a disarm attempt fails, the trap doesn’t trigger, and you can try to disarm the trap again. If you fail a second time, the trap triggers.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.summary: An innate spellcaster shaping arcane magic with metamagic and sorcery points.
classes.spellcasting: Arcane spells known. Sorcery points for metamagic and flexible casting.

abilities.name: Font of Magic
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Internal wellspring of sorcery points.

Sorcery points per progression table. Regain on long rest. Convert points ↔ spell levels per BFRD flexible casting (also use Spell Power in YMIAT).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Arcane spells known.

As a conduit for Arcane magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Sorcerer progression table.

You know a fixed list of spells and do not prepare them daily. Learn additional spells at the levels shown on your class progression table.

Spellcasting ability: Willpower (WIL). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Willpower (WIL) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

abilities.name: Metamagic
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Twist spells with sorcery points.

Choose Metamagic options (Careful, Quickened, Twinned, Heightened, etc.). Gain more options at 4th, 8th, and 10th level. One option per spell unless noted.

Quickened Spell still costs 2 points; the spell uses your action (not a separate bonus action in YMIAT).

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a magic talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a magic talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the magic talents list.

abilities.name: Sorcerous Renewal
abilities.summary: Recover sorcery points on short rest.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Recover sorcery points on short rest.

After a short rest, roll 1d4+1 sorcery points (2d4+1 at 6th, 3d4+1 at 9th).

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Arcane Instruction or Innate Spell.

Arcane Instruction: spend 1 point to add Willpower to failed check. Innate Spell: learn a 1st–2nd level spell castable with sorcery points.

abilities.name: Devour Spell
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Absorb hostile spell energy.

Reaction when targeted by a spell: Willpower check DC 10 + spell level. On success, targets have advantage on saves and half damage; you gain sorcery points equal to the spell level. Once per long rest (or spend 4 points to reuse).

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Share spell effects with another target.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Share spell effects with another target.

Reaction when a spell affects you: a creature you see within 120 feet is also affected. Once per rest (or spend 10 sorcery points).

subclasses.name: Chaos
subclasses.summary: Wild surges of uncontrolled arcane power.

features.name: Chaos Manifestation
features.summary: Random surge on crit or dropping foes with spell attacks.
features.descriptionHtml:
Random surge on crit or dropping foes with spell attacks.

When you reduce creatures to 0 Wounds or score a critical hit with a spell attack, roll d6 on the Chaos Manifestation table (invisibility, force burst, AC bonus, phasing, magical darkness, or teleport-with-risk). Once per turn.

features.name: Chaos Origin Spells
features.summary: Always-known chaos origin spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known chaos origin spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: misty step, shatter
  • Level 5: blink, hypnotic pattern
  • Level 7: compulsion, polymorph
  • Level 9: seeming, telekinesis
  • Level 10: eyebite, irresistible dance

features.name: Volatile Magic
features.summary: Leveled spells may trigger extra volatile effects.
features.descriptionHtml:
Leveled spells may trigger extra volatile effects.

When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, roll d20 vs volatile DC (20 − sorcerer level + spell level). On a failure the spell still resolves but you also roll on the Volatile Spell Effect table (see Player's Guide). At 0 Luck, roll twice and take the higher result.

features.name: Embrace Chaos
features.summary: Bonus action: suffer a volatile effect for sorcery points or temp Wounds.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus action: suffer a volatile effect for sorcery points or temp Wounds.

As a free action, roll on the Volatile Spell Effect table and suffer it as if targeted. Even result = gain PB sorcery points; odd result = gain temp Wounds = Fitness score for 1 hour. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Inflict Disorder
features.summary: Redirect volatile effects onto attackers.
features.descriptionHtml:
Redirect volatile effects onto attackers.

When targeted by a spell or attack, use your reaction to roll on the Volatile Spell Effect table; spend 1 sorcery point to force the attacker to suffer the effect instead. Once per long rest, or spend 2 sorcery points to reuse.

features.name: Apotheosis of Discord
features.summary: 6th-level+ spells trigger a minute of chaotic mastery.
features.descriptionHtml:
6th-level+ spells trigger a minute of chaotic mastery.

When you cast a spell of 6th level or higher, become a conduit for 1 minute (until unconscious): metamagic costs −1 (min 0); resistance to all damage until end of next turn after casting a leveled spell; cast any known Arcane or origin spell (≤1 minute casting, spell level ≤ half PB) without slots or components. Once per long rest, or spend 15 sorcery points.

subclasses.name: Draconic
subclasses.summary: Innate power from draconic ancestry.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.summary: Natural AC and extra Max Wounds.
features.descriptionHtml:
Natural AC and extra Max Wounds.

While not wearing armor: AC = 10 + Fitness modifier + Willpower modifier. Max Wounds increase by 1 per sorcerer level.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.summary: Draconic language and affinity; origin spells by dragon type.
features.descriptionHtml:
Draconic language and affinity; origin spells by dragon type.

Choose a dragon type (sets damage type for later features). Speak, read, and write Draconic. On dragon-related ability checks, treat d20 rolls below your sorcerer level as equal to your sorcerer level.

You learn additional origin spells at 2nd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level per BFRD Draconic Origin table (adapted to YMIAT spell levels).

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.summary: Add Willpower modifier to one damage roll of your ancestry type per cast.
features.descriptionHtml:
Add Willpower modifier to one damage roll of your ancestry type per cast.

When you cast a spell that deals damage of your ancestry type, add your Willpower modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

features.name: Imperious Wings
features.summary: Sprout wings for fly speed.
features.descriptionHtml:
Sprout wings for fly speed.

As a free action, sprout wings for fly speed equal to walking speed until dismissed. Creatures that see you have disadvantage avoiding frighten/intimidate. Can't use while wearing armor.

features.name: Draconic Vengeance
features.summary: Brand a foe vulnerable to your element.
features.descriptionHtml:
Brand a foe vulnerable to your element.

Action: target within 60 feet makes Willpower save or becomes vulnerable to your ancestry damage type until end of your next turn (immunity unchanged). Once per long rest, or spend 4 sorcery points to reuse.

subclasses.name: Abominable
subclasses.summary: You receive your magic from the primordial beings who existed before the creation of reality and that remain uncaring about its existence or their horrific

features.summary: You gain origin spells at the sorcerer levels listed in

You gain origin spells at the sorcerer levels listed in

You gain origin spells at the sorcerer levels listed in the Abominable Origin Spells table. See the Sorcerer

features.name: Physical
features.summary: Your body undergoes subtle transformations as you
features.descriptionHtml:
Your body undergoes subtle transformations as you

Your body undergoes subtle transformations as you embrace your otherworldly origin. Vital organs shift or merge without any negative impact to you, but they make it more difficult for others to inflict grievous harm to you.

subclasses.name: Cyclonic
subclasses.summary: The power of the storm thunders within you. The magic that courses through you is as inescapable as a blizzard, as undeniable as a hurricane. Highly prized as sailors

features.name: Cyclonic Origin Spells
features.summary: You gain origin spells at the sorcerer levels listed in the
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain origin spells at the sorcerer levels listed in the

You gain origin spells at the sorcerer levels listed in the

features.name: Stormborn
features.summary: The storm magic within you is tied forever to the elemental
features.descriptionHtml:
The storm magic within you is tied forever to the elemental

The storm magic within you is tied forever to the elemental planes. You gain the following benefits: • While you are outdoors on the Material Plane or the

subclasses.name: Sacred
subclasses.summary: Your magical power derives from a deity. An avatar or a powerful celestial or fiendish proxy might feature in your distant ancestry, or you might be linked to a major

features.name: Divine Providence
features.summary: Your divine nature grants you a minor amount of grace.
features.descriptionHtml:
Your divine nature grants you a minor amount of grace.

Your divine nature grants you a minor amount of grace.

features.name: Metamagic: Divine
features.summary: You gain the following unique option for your Metamagic
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain the following unique option for your Metamagic

You gain the following unique option for your Metamagic feature (see Player’s Guide). This option can’t be replaced and doesn’t count against the number of Metamagic options that you know.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.summary: A pact-bound spellcaster with eldritch invocations and short-rest recovery.
classes.proficiencies: Light and medium armor, shields, simple weapons.
classes.spellcasting: Arcane spells (pact magic). Few slots, short-rest recovery. Invocations at 2nd level.

abilities.name: Eldritch Invocations
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Customize your pact with invocations.

Choose invocations from the BFRD Warlock list. Gain more at the levels shown on your progression table. Prerequisites apply.

abilities.name: Pact Magic
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Few slots, short-rest recovery.

Pact spell slots per progression table (all slots are your slot level). Regain on short or long rest. Also cast using Spell Power per YMIAT rules. Spells known per table.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a magic talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a magic talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the magic talents list.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Warlock heroic boon per BFRD.

Choose a heroic boon from the BFRD Warlock list, adapted for YMIAT.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Warlock epic boon per BFRD.

Gain your Warlock Epic Boon from BFRD, adapted for YMIAT.

subclasses.name: Archfey
subclasses.summary: Bargains with capricious fey lords.

features.name: Archfey Pact Spells
features.summary: Always-known archfey pact spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known archfey pact spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: faerie fire, sleep
  • Level 5: calm emotions, phantasmal force
  • Level 9: blink, plant growth
  • Level 10: dominate beast, greater invisibility

features.name: Fey Presence
features.summary: Action: charm or frighten creatures near you.
features.descriptionHtml:
Action: charm or frighten creatures near you.

As an action, each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you makes a Willpower save or is charmed or frightened (your choice) until end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.summary: Turn invisible and teleport when hit.
features.descriptionHtml:
Turn invisible and teleport when hit.

When you take damage, use your reaction to become invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Invisibility lasts until start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.summary: Immune to charm; charmer must save or be charmed by you.
features.descriptionHtml:
Immune to charm; charmer must save or be charmed by you.

You can't be charmed. When a creature tries to charm you, it makes a Willpower save; on a failure it is charmed by you for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.summary: Trap a foe in a fey illusion.
features.descriptionHtml:
Trap a foe in a fey illusion.

As an action, one creature within 60 feet makes a Willpower save or is charmed and incapacitated, perceiving itself in an idyllic fey realm. The effect ends after 1 minute, if you dismiss it (no action), if the target takes damage, or if someone uses an action to shake the target awake. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Fiend
subclasses.summary: Power from a greater fiend patron.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.summary: Temp HP when foes fall nearby.
features.descriptionHtml:
Temp HP when foes fall nearby.

When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Wounds, or one within 30 feet does, gain temporary Wounds equal to PB + warlock level until expended or long rest.

features.name: Fiend Pact Spells
features.summary: Always-known fiend pact spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known fiend pact spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: burning hands, command
  • Level 5: scorching ray, suggestion
  • Level 9: fireball, stinking cloud
  • Level 10: blight, wall of fire

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.summary: Add 1d10 to a failed check or save.
features.descriptionHtml:
Add 1d10 to a failed check or save.

When you make an ability check or save, add 1d10. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.summary: Resistance to a chosen damage type.
features.descriptionHtml:
Resistance to a chosen damage type.

After a short or long rest, choose a damage type. You have resistance until you choose again.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.summary: Banish attacker through a nightmare.
features.descriptionHtml:
Banish attacker through a nightmare.

When you hit with an attack, the target disappears until end of your next turn, then returns (or nearest space). Non-fiends take 10d10 psychic damage. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Great Old One
subclasses.summary: Whispers from beyond the stars.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.summary: Telepathy with creatures you can see.
features.descriptionHtml:
Telepathy with creatures you can see.

You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 30 feet. You don't need to share a language, but the target must understand at least one language.

features.name: Great Old One Pact Spells
features.summary: Always-known GOO pact spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-known GOO pact spells.

These domain spells are always prepared:

  • Level 2: dissonant whispers, hideous laughter
  • Level 5: detect thoughts, phantasmal force
  • Level 9: clairvoyance, sending
  • Level 10: dominate beast, evard's black tentacles

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.summary: Impose disadvantage on an attack against you.
features.descriptionHtml:
Impose disadvantage on an attack against you.

When a creature makes an attack roll against you, use your reaction to impose disadvantage. If the attack misses, you have advantage on the next attack roll you make against that creature before end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.summary: Psychic resistance; reflect psychic damage to attackers.
features.descriptionHtml:
Psychic resistance; reflect psychic damage to attackers.

You have resistance to psychic damage. When a creature deals psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of psychic damage.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.summary: Permanently charm a humanoid (until broken).
features.descriptionHtml:
Permanently charm a humanoid (until broken).

As an action, one humanoid within 30 feet makes a Willpower save or is charmed by you until you use this feature again or until you die. The thrall obeys telepathic commands if you are on the same plane. The target repeats the save every time it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Archon
subclasses.summary: Your patron is an otherworldly being bound to the forces of law and order. Archon patrons relentlessly pursue whichever cosmic plan guides their path, eliminating anything that

features.name: Equalize
features.summary: As a reaction when you or a creature you can see would
features.descriptionHtml:
As a reaction when you or a creature you can see would

As a reaction when you or a creature you can see would make an ability check, attack roll, or save with advantage or disadvantage, you can cancel out all sources of advantage or disadvantage, forcing the creature to roll a single d20 to determine the outcome. Once you use this feature to modify a check, that check can’t be modified by any sources of advantage or disadvantage or by spending any amount of Luck.

features.name: Restore Efficiency
features.summary: As a bonus action, you can expend a Wyrd spell slot of
features.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, you can expend a Wyrd spell slot of

As a free action, you can expend a Wyrd spell level of 1st level or higher to end one condition or magical effect that affects you or a creature you touch. If the effect is the product of a spell equal to or less than the level expended, it automatically ends. For effects created by spells of a higher level than expended, make a

features.name: Entropic Dispersal
features.summary: As a reaction when you take damage, you can disperse
features.descriptionHtml:
As a reaction when you take damage, you can disperse

As a reaction when you take damage, you can disperse some of that damage into a nearby creature. The damage you take is reduced by an amount up to your warlock level, and one creature you can see within 5 feet of you instead takes that amount of damage. If the target is unwilling, it can make a CON save against your spell save DC. On a success or if the target is immune to that type of damage, the target doesn’t take the damage, and the damage you take isn’t reduced.

features.name: Invoke Order
features.summary: You can call upon your patron to correct imbalances that
features.descriptionHtml:
You can call upon your patron to correct imbalances that

You can call upon your patron to correct imbalances that threaten fulfilment of the cosmic plan. As an action, you can expend a use of your Pact Magic feature (see Player’s

subclasses.summary: Your patron is an elemental entity with dominion over a sizeable territory within its elemental plane. You are one of its elemental representatives on the Material Plane, and

features.descriptionHtml:
Whenever you use your Eldritch Blast feature (see Player’s

Whenever you use your Eldritch Blast feature (see Player’s

features.summary: You gain pact spells at the warlock levels listed in the
features.descriptionHtml:

You gain pact spells at the warlock levels listed in the
