subclasses.summary: Your patron is an immortal fey, one whose existence predates the advent of mortals. The patron’s intentions remain unknown to you, or it might deceive you about

features.name: Fey Noble Pact Spells
features.summary: You gain pact spells at the warlock levels listed in the Fey
features.descriptionHtml:
You gain pact spells at the warlock levels listed in the Fey

You gain pact spells at the warlock levels listed in the Fey

features.name: Fey Presence
features.summary: Your patron’s power inures you to fey trickery and allows
features.descriptionHtml:
Your patron’s power inures you to fey trickery and allows

Your patron’s power inures you to fey trickery and allows you to use some of it yourself. You are resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions, and you have advantage on ability checks and saves to discern the truth of an illusion.

features.name: Death Ruse
features.summary: As a reaction when you take damage, you can fall prone
features.descriptionHtml:
As a reaction when you take damage, you can fall prone

As a reaction when you take damage, you can fall prone and appear to have been reduced to 0 HP. Make a CHA (Deception) check. This becomes the DC for creatures making WIS (Insight or Medicine) checks to determine if you’re actually dead. If you attack a creature that hasn’t successfully determined that you aren’t dead or unconscious, you have advantage on your attack roll, and if you target such a creature with a spell, it has disadvantage on the save. Once you have gained this benefit against a creature or once a creature has seen through your ruse, that creature can’t be affected by this feature again for 1 hour.

features.name: Emotional Redirection
features.summary: The emotional frivolity of the fey has steeled you against
features.descriptionHtml:
The emotional frivolity of the fey has steeled you against

The emotional frivolity of the fey has steeled you against attempts at manipulating your emotions and made you better at influencing the emotions of others. You are immune to the charmed and frightened conditions, and you can use your Fey Presence feature a number of times equal to your PB, regaining all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Induce Fugue State
features.summary: As an action, you can create an illusory scenario that
features.descriptionHtml:
As an action, you can create an illusory scenario that

As an action, you can create an illusory scenario that draws creatures into it. Choose a number of targets equal to your PB within 60 feet of you that you can see. Each target must make a WIS save against your spell save

classes.name: Wizard
classes.summary: A scholarly arcane caster with a spellbook and ritual mastery.
classes.spellcasting: Arcane spells (prepared from spellbook). Rituals and rote spells.

abilities.name: Arcane Recovery
abilities.summary: Recover Spell Power on a short rest.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Recover Spell Power on a short rest.

Once per day on a short rest, recover expended spell levels totaling half your wizard level (rounded up) as Spell Power, or per BFRD slot recovery adapted to SP.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Prepared Arcane spells from spellbook.

As a conduit for Arcane magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Wizard progression table.

You keep a spellbook. Prepare spells from it equal to your Insight (INS) modifier + your wizard level (minimum one). Add two spells to your spellbook each time you gain a level.

Spellcasting ability: Insight (INS). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Insight (INS) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

abilities.name: Magic Sense
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Detect magic within 30 feet.

Action: until end of next turn, sense spellcasters, ongoing spell effects, and magic items within 30 feet (blocked by 1 ft stone, 1 in metal, thin lead, 3 ft wood/dirt). Uses = PB + 1 per long rest.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a magic talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a magic talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the magic talents list.

abilities.name: Rote Spell
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared signature spells.

Choose one spell each at 3rd (1st level), 5th (2nd), 7th (3rd), and 9th (4th) character level as always-prepared rote spells. Swap during a long rest.

abilities.name: Superior Recovery
abilities.summary: Swap prepared spells during Arcane Recovery.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Swap prepared spells during Arcane Recovery.

When you use Arcane Recovery, swap up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) prepared spells from your spellbook.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Rite of the Ritualist or Source Master.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Rite of the Ritualist or Source Master.

Ritualist: learn rituals from any magic source. Source Master: add spells from Divine, Primordial, or Wyrd when leveling.

abilities.name: Spellguard
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Resist hostile magic.

Advantage on saves against spells; resistance to damage from spells and spell attacks.

abilities.name: Spell Mastery
abilities.summary: Cast rote spells without spending slots.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Cast rote spells without spending slots.

Cast each rote spell once per short rest at lowest level without spending Spell Power.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Chance to recover spent spell power.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Chance to recover spent spell power.

When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher using Spell Power, roll d10. If the result exceeds the level spent, recover that Spell Power. Once per short rest.

subclasses.name: Battle Mage
subclasses.summary: Arcane offense with martial discipline.

features.name: Expanded Talent List
features.summary: Magic or martial talents on Improvement.
features.descriptionHtml:
Magic or martial talents on Improvement.

When you gain a talent from Improvement, choose from magic or martial talent lists.

features.name: Spell Ward
features.summary: AC and physical resistance after casting.
features.descriptionHtml:
AC and physical resistance after casting.

When you cast an Arcane spell of 1st level+, weave a ward for 1 minute: +PB AC and resistance to B/P/S (ends if unconscious or you end a turn without casting a leveled spell). PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Tactical Caster
features.summary: Allies immune to your damaging spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Allies immune to your damaging spells.

When you cast a damaging Arcane spell, choose yourself and allies you can see to be immune to that spell's damage. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Contingency Plan
features.summary: Redirect missed spell attack to another target.
features.descriptionHtml:
Redirect missed spell attack to another target.

When a spell attack misses, use your reaction to redirect it to a different target in range with a new attack roll.

features.name: Blasting Power
features.summary: Empowered spell damage after successful saves.
features.descriptionHtml:
Empowered spell damage after successful saves.

When a creature succeeds on a save against your Arcane spell but takes no damage, it takes force damage equal to spell level d6 + Insight modifier.

features.name: Counterstrike
features.summary: Punish creatures that save against your spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Punish creatures that save against your spells.

When a creature succeeds on a save against your Arcane spell and would suffer no effect, it takes force damage per Blasting Power. Once per turn.

subclasses.name: Cantrip Adept
subclasses.summary: Cantrip mastery and ritual ingenuity.

features.name: Arcane Alacrity
features.summary: Cast action cantrips as bonus actions.
features.descriptionHtml:
Cast action cantrips as bonus actions.

When you cast an Arcane cantrip with casting time 1 action, you can cast it as a bonus action for that casting. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Cantrip Polymath
features.summary: Learn cantrips from any magic source.
features.descriptionHtml:
Learn cantrips from any magic source.

Learn two cantrips from any spell list; they count as Arcane cantrips and don't count against cantrips known. Any cantrip from lineage or talents also counts as Arcane for you.

features.name: Versatile Cantrips
features.summary: Swap one cantrip after each rest.
features.descriptionHtml:
Swap one cantrip after each rest.

When you finish a short or long rest, replace one Arcane cantrip you know with another from your available lists (including Polymath picks).

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.summary: Add Insight to one cantrip damage roll.
features.descriptionHtml:
Add Insight to one cantrip damage roll.

Add your Insight modifier to one damage roll of any Arcane cantrip you cast.

features.name: Empowered Cantrips
features.summary: Maximum damage on cantrips.
features.descriptionHtml:
Maximum damage on cantrips.

Once per turn when you cast a damaging Arcane cantrip, deal maximum damage. PB uses per long rest.

subclasses.name: Arcanist
subclasses.summary: Among wizards, who might mollify their curiosity with any manner of research, the Arcanist is often considered the most preoccupied with the empirical and esoteric

features.name: Economical Transcription
features.summary: Your ability to collect, decipher, and recall spells is
features.descriptionHtml:
Your ability to collect, decipher, and recall spells is

Your ability to collect, decipher, and recall spells is unmatched. When you finish a short or long rest, you can replace one Arcane cantrip that you know with another cantrip from the Arcane source spell list.

features.name: Swift Ritual
features.summary: As an action, you can cast an Arcane ritual that you have
features.descriptionHtml:
As an action, you can cast an Arcane ritual that you have

As an action, you can cast an Arcane ritual that you have scribed within your spellbook, instead of requiring the ritual’s normal casting time. To do so, the ritual can’t be an evocation spell, and it can’t have a casting time greater than 10 minutes. You must still provide all components necessary for the casting of the spell. Once used, you can’t use this feature again until you finish a long rest. 1 CLASS OPTIONS 99

features.name: Arcane Conflux
features.summary: Each time you miss a spell attack roll and for each creature
features.descriptionHtml:
Each time you miss a spell attack roll and for each creature

Each time you miss a spell attack roll and for each creature that succeeds on a save against a spell you cast, you gain a cumulative +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save

features.name: Eidetic Scribe
features.summary: As a reaction when a creature that you can see and hear
features.descriptionHtml:
As a reaction when a creature that you can see and hear

As a reaction when a creature that you can see and hear casts a spell from the Arcane source list, you can attempt to memorize it. Make an INT (Arcana) check with a DC of 10 + the spell’s level. On a success, you can cast that spell as though you have it prepared until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Mastered Spell
features.summary: As part of a long rest, you can select one non‑ritual
features.descriptionHtml:
As part of a long rest, you can select one non‑ritual

As part of a long rest, you can select one non‑ritual spell of 3rd level or lower that you have scribed within your spellbook and master it. That spell is always prepared for you and doesn’t count against the number of spells you can prepare. You can cast that spell at its lowest level without expending Spell Power, though you must still supply any spell components.

subclasses.name: Necromancer
subclasses.summary: Some wizards are naturally drawn to necromancy, and others are turned to it by trauma—learning the incredible power of using the dead to do their bidding as they attempt

features.name: Reanimation Rites
features.summary: Your study of death and the Undead has made you adept at
features.descriptionHtml:
Your study of death and the Undead has made you adept at

Your study of death and the Undead has made you adept at using necromantic magic. You can add any spell from the necromancy school to your spellbook, regardless of its spell source. These spells count as Arcane spells for you.

features.name: Undead Thrall
features.summary: You can spend 1 minute touching a pile of bones or the
features.descriptionHtml:
You can spend 1 minute touching a pile of bones or the

You can spend 1 minute touching a pile of bones or the corpse of a Medium or Small Beast or Humanoid (or

features.name: Enhanced Undead
features.summary: You can cast the animate dead ritual spell as an action instead
features.descriptionHtml:
You can cast the animate dead ritual spell as an action instead

You can cast the animate dead ritual spell as an action instead of its normal casting time, and you can ignore the material spell component when you do so. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your PB, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Necromantic Reversal
features.summary: Necromantic Reversal — Necromancer subclass feature.
features.descriptionHtml:
Necromantic Reversal — Necromancer subclass feature.

Necromantic Reversal: see Tales of the Valiant Player's Guide 2 (Necromancer subclass).

features.name: Monstrous Creations
features.summary: When you cast the animate dead ritual spell, you can now
features.descriptionHtml:
When you cast the animate dead ritual spell, you can now

When you cast the animate dead ritual spell, you can now target Medium or Small Beasts and Humanoids (and

subclasses.name: Summoner
subclasses.summary: Every good adventurer knows that surrounding yourself with quality companions is a must. Summoners know that quantity is just as important. Why put yourself in jeopardy

features.name: Conjuration Specialist
features.summary: You are adept at using magic that creates or summons
features.descriptionHtml:
You are adept at using magic that creates or summons

You are adept at using magic that creates or summons creatures. You can add any spell from the conjuration school to your spellbook, provided that spell conjures, creates, or summons one or more creatures, such as the find steed and conjure woodland beings spells. These spells count as Arcane spells for you. This feature doesn’t apply to spells from the conjuration school that don’t create or summon actual creatures, such as the guardian of faith and spirit guardians spells. 1 CLASS OPTIONS 101

features.name: Unbreakable Focus
features.summary: You have advantage on CON saves to maintain
features.descriptionHtml:
You have advantage on CON saves to maintain

You have advantage on CON saves to maintain concentration on spells from the conjuration school.

features.name: Master Summoner
features.summary: You can have one additional spell from your Rote Spell
features.descriptionHtml:
You can have one additional spell from your Rote Spell

You can have one additional spell from your Rote Spell feature (see Player’s Guide) per spell level for which you already have a rote spell. These extra rote spells must be spells from the conjuration school that create or summon one or more creatures.

features.name: Synchronized Companions
features.summary: A friendly creature that isn’t a creature you created or
features.descriptionHtml:
A friendly creature that isn’t a creature you created or

A friendly creature that isn’t a creature you created or summoned with a spell has advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of a creature that you created or summoned with a spell from the conjuration school, provided the creature you created or summoned isn’t incapacitated.

features.name: Twinned Conjuration
features.summary: When you cast a spell from the conjuration school that
features.descriptionHtml:
When you cast a spell from the conjuration school that

When you cast a spell from the conjuration school that creates or summons a creature, you can create or summon twice as many creatures, unless the spell prevents you from having more than one creature at a time, such as the create familiar spell.

classes.name: Theurge
classes.summary: A dual-source caster who prepares Arcane and Divine spells from a mystic libram and manipulates magic with Spellcraft.
classes.proficiencies: Simple weapons. Skills: choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, and Religion.
classes.spellcasting: Arcane and Divine spells (prepared from libram). Rituals known per level. Must include spells from both lists when learning.

abilities.name: Spell Nexus
abilities.summary: Swap prepared spells through your libram.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Swap prepared spells through your libram.

As a bonus action while your libram is within 100 feet, open a conduit to instantly replace one prepared spell with another of the same spell level and source (Arcane or Divine) transcribed in your libram.

Uses per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.summary: Prepared Arcane and Divine spells from your libram.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Prepared Arcane and Divine spells from your libram.

As a conduit for Arcane and Divine magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Theurge progression table.

You prepare spells in advance. You can prepare a number of spells equal to your Insight (INS) modifier + your theurge level (minimum one). Change your prepared list during a long rest.

Spellcasting ability: Insight (INS). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Insight (INS) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

Libram: Your Tiny magical libram holds all spells you know except cantrips. At 1st level it contains six 1st-level spells (at least two Arcane and two Divine). Only you can read it. Replace a lost libram with a 1-hour ceremony.

When you gain a theurge level, add one Arcane and one Divine spell to your libram. You may swap one spell in your libram for another of the same source when you level.

abilities.name: Spellcraft
abilities.summary: Insight dice to manipulate spell outcomes.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Insight dice to manipulate spell outcomes.

You have Spellcraft dice equal to your Insight modifier (minimum 1). They are d6s (d8 at 9th level). Regain expended dice on a short or long rest.

Spend one die (roll immediately) to:

  • Add the result to damage or healing from a spell you cast.
  • Add the result to a Fitness save to maintain concentration.
  • Add the result to a check to learn, decipher, or recall magical information.

abilities.name: Summon Libram
abilities.summary: Sense and recall your libram across planes.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Sense and recall your libram across planes.

While your libram is on the same plane, you know its distance and direction. As a bonus action on the same plane, summon it to your hand or an adjacent space.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a magic talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a magic talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the magic talents list.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Careful Craft, Persistent Craft, or Precise Craft.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Careful Craft, Persistent Craft, or Precise Craft.

Choose one ToV theurge heroic boon: Careful Craft (Spellcraft die not expended on failed boost), Persistent Craft (force reroll on successful save vs. your spell), or Precise Craft (reroll 1s on Spellcraft dice).

abilities.name: Spell Synthesis
abilities.summary: Cast Arcane and Divine spells in one turn.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Cast Arcane and Divine spells in one turn.

Once per short or long rest, cast two prepared spells of 4th level or lower on your turn: one Arcane and one Divine. Use action + bonus action, or cast two action spells with one Cast a Spell action. Each spell costs Spell Power normally.

You cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Superior Focus
abilities.summary: Dual concentration on Arcane and Divine spells.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Dual concentration on Arcane and Divine spells.

Concentrate on one Arcane and one Divine spell at once. At the start of each turn, make a Fitness save (DC 10 + highest spell level) or both spells end. You have disadvantage on concentration saves from damage while holding both.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Epic theurge boon from ToV Player's Guide 2.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Epic theurge boon from ToV Player's Guide 2.

Choose an epic boon from the ToV theurge list (adapted for YMIAT), such as expanded Spell Synthesis uses or enhanced libram range.

subclasses.name: Conduit
subclasses.summary: Exchange vitality for spell power and disrupt enemy magic.

features.name: Energy Exchange
features.summary: Trade Recovery Points or spell levels for spell recovery or item charges.
features.descriptionHtml:
Trade Recovery Points or spell levels for spell recovery or item charges.

Exchange Life: Bonus action: expend Recovery Points equal to a spell level to recover that level (lose Wounds equal to rolls + Fitness modifier; reduce Max Wounds until long rest).

Exchange Power: Action: expend a spell level to restore charges to a touched magic item.

features.name: Mystic Vitality
features.summary: Unspent spell levels become Recovery Points on rest.
features.descriptionHtml:
Unspent spell levels become Recovery Points on rest.

After a long rest, regain extra Recovery Points equal to half your unspent spell levels (rounded down), up to your maximum.

features.name: Metabolize
features.summary: Store incoming energy to upcast a spell.
features.descriptionHtml:
Store incoming energy to upcast a spell.

Reaction when you take non-B/P/S damage: Fitness save (DC 10 or half damage). On success, store energy up to 1 minute; expend it to cast a spell one level higher. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Spell Surge
features.summary: Expend Recovery Points to add spell damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Expend Recovery Points to add spell damage.

When your Arcane or Divine spell damages a creature, expend Recovery Points and add Fitness modifier; one target takes extra damage of the spell's type.

features.name: Nullify
features.summary: Suppress a creature's or item's magic.
features.descriptionHtml:
Suppress a creature's or item's magic.

Action: suppress magic on one creature or item within 120 feet for 1 minute. Creatures must pass Fitness saves to cast or attack with magic. Items function as nonmagical. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Illuminary
subclasses.summary: Inscribe sacred signs and sigils to extend your magic.

features.name: Mystic Scribe
features.summary: Learn languages and artist tools mastery.
features.descriptionHtml:
Learn languages and artist tools mastery.

Gain artist's tools proficiency (double PB if proficient). Over 10 minutes, temporarily learn a language until you use this again.

features.name: Sacred Sign
features.summary: Mark allies to cast touch spells at range.
features.descriptionHtml:
Mark allies to cast touch spells at range.

Bonus action: inscribe your symbol on a willing creature for 10 minutes. While active, cast touch spells on them within 120 feet; action to see through their senses.

Active symbols: 1 at 2nd level, 2 at 4th, 3 at 6th, 4 at 8th.

features.name: Spell Sigil
features.summary: Store spells in inscribed items.
features.descriptionHtml:
Store spells in inscribed items.

Action: inscribe a spell into a worn/wielded item for 24 hours. You or a designated ally activates it with an action. Half PB sigils active at once.

features.name: Guarding Glyph
features.summary: Marked allies share defensive bonuses.
features.descriptionHtml:
Marked allies share defensive bonuses.

When you mark a creature with Sacred Sign, you gain a reciprocal mark. You and marked allies within 30 feet gain +1 AC and saves per marked ally nearby.

features.name: Potent Symbol
features.summary: Cast symbol without cost.
features.descriptionHtml:
Cast symbol without cost.

Action: cast symbol without Spell Power or components. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Source Spinner
subclasses.summary: Unravel and realign the weave of magic.

features.name: Magic Theory
features.summary: Bonus Spellcraft on magic knowledge; extra prepared spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Bonus Spellcraft on magic knowledge; extra prepared spells.

Add a Spellcraft die to magic knowledge checks without expending it. Gain additional always-prepared spells (detect magic, perceive vulnerability, and higher-level spells as you level).

features.name: Overwrite
features.summary: End a spell when you cast on the same target.
features.descriptionHtml:
End a spell when you cast on the same target.

When you cast a spell on a creature, attempt to end one ongoing spell on it (auto if equal/lower spell level; otherwise Insight check vs. 10 + spell level).

features.name: Mystic Realignment
features.summary: Trade spell levels for recovered levels.
features.descriptionHtml:
Trade spell levels for recovered levels.

Bonus action: exchange spell levels for recovered levels of equal or lesser total value (see ToV Source Spinner rules).

features.name: Unravel
features.summary: Turn failed saves into successes.
features.descriptionHtml:
Turn failed saves into successes.

Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet fails a save vs. magic, cause success instead; source takes force damage equal to your theurge level. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Spell Loom
features.summary: Manipulate magic in a small area.
features.descriptionHtml:
Manipulate magic in a small area.

Action: for 1 minute, heal when casting spells, redirect single-target spells that miss or you save against, and gain temp Wounds. Once per short or long rest.

classes.name: Vanguard
classes.summary: A battlefield commander who plants war banners, issues stratagems, and shields allies through tactical leadership.
classes.proficiencies: All armor, shields, simple and martial weapons. Skills: choose two from Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, and Persuasion.

abilities.name: Born Leader
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Authority or Community leadership aura.

Choose a leadership quality at 1st level:

  • Authority. A friendly creature starting its turn within 5 feet adds your PB to weapon damage on hits until end of turn. Gain Intimidation proficiency (double PB if already proficient).
  • Community. A friendly creature ending its turn within 5 feet gains PB on its first save before your next turn. Gain Persuasion proficiency (double PB if already proficient).

Allies benefit only while you are conscious.

abilities.name: War Banner
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Mystical battle standard in combat.

As an action during encounter play, plant a war banner in an adjacent space. It lasts 1 minute (or until you end it, plant another, move 120+ feet away, or become incapacitated).

Creatures within 15 feet who can see the banner are affected. Start with Banner of Mercy (banner absorbs ally damage up to 10 × vanguard level Wounds) and Black Flag (foes have disadvantage on first attack each turn).

PB uses per long rest; only one banner at a time.

abilities.name: Stratagems
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Tactical commands on the battlefield.

You learn stratagems—commands that reposition allies, grant advantage, or disrupt enemies. At 2nd level you know two; learn more as you level. Superior Stratagems (5th) unlocks advanced options from the ToV vanguard list.

abilities.name: Support Action
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Stabilize and rally fallen allies.

You gain a Support Action each turn in combat. Use it to stabilize a dying ally (they regain Wounds equal to vanguard level + Willpower modifier and become conscious), grant temporary Wounds, or execute other support options from the ToV vanguard rules.

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a martial talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a martial talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the martial talents list.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.summary: Two attacks with the Attack action.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Two attacks with the Attack action.

Your physical prowess has grown. On your turn, you can make up to two attacks when you take the Attack action.

In YMIAT, each successful weapon attack typically inflicts 1 Wound (2 on a critical hit). Weapon bonuses apply to hit, not to the number of Wounds dealt.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Vanguard heroic boon from ToV PG2.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Vanguard heroic boon from ToV PG2.

Choose a vanguard heroic boon from the ToV Player's Guide 2 list, adapted for YMIAT.

abilities.name: War Banner: Lucky Colors
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Third war banner option.

Gain the Lucky Colors war banner: allies within range gain a bonus to Defense or saves (per ToV vanguard rules).

abilities.name: Manifold Tactic
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Combine two stratagems.

When you use a stratagem, you can apply a second stratagem effect on the same turn once per short or long rest.

abilities.name: Battlefield Resolve
abilities.summary: Push through pain on the front line.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Push through pain on the front line.

When you fail a save, you can expend a Recovery Point to reroll. You must use the new result.

abilities.name: Valiant Commander
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Extend banner and stratagem range.

Your war banner range increases to 30 feet. Once per turn when you use a stratagem, you can affect one additional valid target.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Vanguard epic boon from ToV PG2.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Vanguard epic boon from ToV PG2.

Choose a vanguard epic boon from the ToV Player's Guide 2 list, adapted for YMIAT.

subclasses.name: Bulwark
subclasses.summary: Battlefield healer and protector with the Surgeon's Standard banner.

features.name: Battlefield Healer
features.summary: Fast stabilization and Medicine mastery.
features.descriptionHtml:
Fast stabilization and Medicine mastery.

Medicine proficiency (double PB if proficient). Stabilize dying creatures as a bonus action; they regain Wounds equal to vanguard level + Willpower modifier.

features.name: War Banner: Surgeon's Standard
features.summary: Healing war banner.
features.descriptionHtml:
Healing war banner.

War banner option: at start of your turns, heal PB allies within range for 1d4 + Willpower (scales to 4d4 at 8th level).

features.name: Safeguard
features.summary: Protect nearby allies.
features.descriptionHtml:
Protect nearby allies.

Bonus action: +2 AC for you and allies within 5 feet until next turn; reaction to redirect single-target attacks/spells to you. PB uses per rest.

features.name: Turn the Tide
features.summary: Mass healing rally.
features.descriptionHtml:
Mass healing rally.

Action: expend vanguard Recovery Points; you and allies within 30 feet regain Wounds equal to total + Willpower modifier.

features.name: Bastion of Defense
features.summary: Enhanced safeguard stance.
features.descriptionHtml:
Enhanced safeguard stance.

While Safeguard is active: temp Wounds when activating; advantage and resistance vs. area damage for nearby allies.

subclasses.name: Herald
subclasses.summary: Living standard-bearer who teleports allies through battle.

features.name: Color Guard
features.summary: Move banners and extend stratagem range.
features.descriptionHtml:
Move banners and extend stratagem range.

Start of turn: move an active banner up to 30 feet. Allies need not see the banner; stratagems need not be seen or heard.

features.name: War Banner: Stirring Sign
features.summary: Speed and extra attack banner.
features.descriptionHtml:
Speed and extra attack banner.

Allies starting turn in banner range double speed, gain advantage on Fitness saves, and can make one extra weapon attack when they Attack.

features.name: Regroup
features.summary: Teleport allies within banner range.
features.descriptionHtml:
Teleport allies within banner range.

Bonus action: teleport yourself or a willing ally within banner radius. Reaction: teleport a damaged ally into the radius.

features.name: Double Standard
features.summary: Two banner effects at once.
features.descriptionHtml:
Two banner effects at once.

When you plant a war banner, choose two active effects instead of one.

features.name: Flag Bearer
features.summary: Unlimited banners and emergency recovery.
features.descriptionHtml:
Unlimited banners and emergency recovery.

War Banner unlimited uses; banners persist if you are incapacitated. End a banner to regain Wounds (level × Willpower) when below half Max Wounds. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Marshal
subclasses.summary: Inspiring commander who coordinates allied strikes.

features.name: Inspiring Leadership
features.summary: Grant advantage via stratagems.
features.descriptionHtml:
Grant advantage via stratagems.

When you use Stratagems, grant advantage on the next attack to 1 ally (2 at 4th, 3 at 6th, 4 at 8th) who can see and hear you.

features.name: War Banner: Banner of Coordination
features.summary: Coordinated attack banner.
features.descriptionHtml:
Coordinated attack banner.

Allies in banner range gain +1 attack per other ally in range (max PB) until start of next turn.

features.name: General's Gambit
features.summary: Spend Recovery Points to fix failed rolls.
features.descriptionHtml:
Spend Recovery Points to fix failed rolls.

When you or an ally within 30 feet fails a check or save, expend a Recovery Point and add the roll to the result.

features.name: Comrade in Arms
features.summary: Share advantage and bonus damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Share advantage and bonus damage.

When Inspiring Leadership grants advantage, you also gain advantage on your next attack. Hits with that advantage deal extra damage equal to PB + Willpower.

features.name: Battlefield Vigor
features.summary: Regain Wounds when bloodied.
features.descriptionHtml:
Regain Wounds when bloodied.

Start of turn below half Max Wounds (but above 0): regain Wounds equal to PB + Fitness modifier.

classes.name: Witch
classes.summary: A Wyrd caster who hexes foes, binds spirits, and draws power from otherworldly covens.
classes.proficiencies: Light armor, simple weapons. Skills: choose two from Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Nature, and Religion.
classes.spellcasting: Wyrd spells (known, not prepared). Rituals known per level. Coven spells from subclass.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.summary: Curse foes with a Hex die.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Curse foes with a Hex die.

As a bonus action, give a creature within 60 feet a Hex die (d6; d8 at 5th, d10 at 9th). When the target makes an attack, check, or save, you can roll and subtract the die (expending it). Only one Hex die per creature.

Uses per long rest equal to your Willpower modifier (minimum 1).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Known Wyrd spells.

As a conduit for Wyrd magic, you cast spells using Spell Power (SP). Spell cost equals spell level. Your max spell level by character level is shown on the Witch progression table.

You know a fixed list of spells and do not prepare them daily. Learn additional spells at the levels shown on your class progression table.

Spellcasting ability: Willpower (WIL). Spell save DC and spell attack modifier use your proficiency bonus + Willpower (WIL) modifier.

Cantrips & rituals: As shown on your progression table. Rituals do not cost Spell Power when cast using the ritual rules in Magic.

Second action casting: If you cast a spell as your second action (because you did not move this turn), spell attacks are at disadvantage and targets have advantage on saves against that spell.

abilities.name: Shadow Craft
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Minor illusions and witch-light craft.

You weave shadow and wyrd into minor effects—hidden messages, obscuring mists, and coven fetishes. Options expand at 6th and 9th level per the ToV witch rules.

abilities.name: Spirit Binding
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Bind helpful spirits.

Over 10 minutes, bind a spirit companion for scouting and spell delivery. At 2nd level you maintain one binding; additional bindings at higher levels per ToV witch progression (adapted to YMIAT 10 levels).

abilities.name: Improvement
abilities.summary: Ability increases or a magic talent.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Ability increases or a magic talent.

At 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th level, choose one improvement (ability modifiers cannot exceed +7 with this feature):

  • Increase a single ability modifier by 2.
  • Increase two different ability modifiers by 1 each.
  • Increase one ability modifier by 1 and select a talent from the magic talents list.

abilities.name: Greater Hex
abilities.summary: Hexed foes struggle to hit you.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Hexed foes struggle to hit you.

When you give a creature a Hex die, it has disadvantage on the first attack roll against you before the die is spent.

abilities.name: Heroic Boon
abilities.summary: Witch heroic boon from ToV PG2.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Witch heroic boon from ToV PG2.

Choose a witch heroic boon from the ToV Player's Guide 2 list, adapted for YMIAT.

abilities.name: Otherworldly Form
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Brief spirit transformation.

As an action, assume an otherworldly form for 1 minute: resistance to nonmagical B/P/S, advantage on Willpower saves, and one coven benefit from your subclass. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Epic Boon
abilities.summary: Witch epic boon from ToV PG2.
abilities.descriptionHtml:
Witch epic boon from ToV PG2.

Choose a witch epic boon from the ToV Player's Guide 2 list, adapted for YMIAT.

subclasses.name: Crimson Cord
subclasses.summary: Vitality witch who heals allies and wastes foes with blood magic.

features.name: Crimson Cord Coven Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared coven spells.
features.descriptionHtml:
Always-prepared coven spells.

Gain coven spells at 2nd, 4th, 6th, and 8th level: cure wounds, inflict wounds, restoration, and higher-level healing and necrotic spells per ToV Crimson Cord table.

features.name: Life Transfer
features.summary: Sacrifice Wounds to heal or harm.
features.descriptionHtml:
Sacrifice Wounds to heal or harm.

Action: sacrifice up to 4 × witch level Wounds to heal one creature within 30 feet or force a Fitness save for necrotic damage. PB uses per short or long rest.

features.name: Wasting Hex
features.summary: Hexes sap vitality.
features.descriptionHtml:
Hexes sap vitality.

When you Hex a creature, it may take 2 × PB Wounds at turn start (Fitness save for half) and can't regain Wounds until next turn.

features.name: Sanguine Link
features.summary: Mystical blood bond.
features.descriptionHtml:
Mystical blood bond.

Action: link with a willing creature (reduce Max Wounds by 10). Linked targets can receive Life Transfer and cure wounds at range. Half PB links active.

features.name: Scarlet Web
features.summary: Area life-drain and healing aura.
features.descriptionHtml:
Area life-drain and healing aura.

Action: for 1 minute, hostiles in 30 feet take Wounds on entry/start of turn; allies ending turn nearby heal. Advantage on Fitness saves; resistance to nonmagical B/P/S. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Night Song
subclasses.summary: Predator witch empowered by darkness and night blessings.

features.name: Night Blessing
features.summary: Darkvision and nightly predator gifts.
features.descriptionHtml:
Darkvision and nightly predator gifts.

Advantage on Stealth in dim light/darkness; darkvision 60 feet (+30 if you already have it). After each long rest, choose Night Children, Night Crawler, or Night Creature blessing.

features.name: Rending Hex
features.summary: Hexed prey takes extra weapon damage.
features.descriptionHtml:
Hexed prey takes extra weapon damage.

When a hexed creature takes weapon damage, add Hex die + Willpower to damage without expending the die. Below half Wounds, Fitness save or allies gain advantage vs. target.

features.name: Draining Curse
features.summary: Curse prey and drain their life.
features.descriptionHtml:
Curse prey and drain their life.

Action or with Hex: sacrifice a Recovery Point to curse a creature for 1 hour; damage to cursed targets heals you up to witch level. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Enhanced Blessing
features.summary: Switch blessings on rest; stronger gifts.
features.descriptionHtml:
Switch blessings on rest; stronger gifts.

Change Night Blessing on short or long rest. Each blessing gains an additional benefit (charm beasts, B/P/S resistance, or fly speed).

features.name: Apex Predator
features.summary: Full night transformation.
features.descriptionHtml:
Full night transformation.

Action: for 1 minute, gain two blessings, advantage vs. cursed targets, and regain 20 Wounds each turn outside sunlight. Once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Twilight Soul
subclasses.summary: Spirit diplomat with a sentinel companion.

features.name: Obscuring Hex
features.summary: Invisible to hexed targets.
features.descriptionHtml:
Invisible to hexed targets.

When you Hex a creature, you are invisible to it for up to 1 minute until you attack, damage, or target it with a spell.

features.name: Spirit Sentinel
features.summary: Tiny spirit scout and spell origin.
features.descriptionHtml:
Tiny spirit scout and spell origin.

10-minute ritual summons a Tiny spirit (bat, raven, cat, etc.). Cast spells from its space; telepathic senses; command Move, Hinder, or Invisible tasks.

features.name: Ephemeral Shroud
features.summary: Teleport away from attacks.
features.descriptionHtml:
Teleport away from attacks.

Reaction when hit by a single-target attack: teleport up to 60 feet; attack misses. PB uses per long rest.

features.name: Welcomed Spirits
features.summary: Ritual communion with spirits.
features.descriptionHtml:
Ritual communion with spirits.

10-minute ceremony: expend Recovery Points to cast augury, speak with dead, or commune with nature without Spell Power.

features.name: Soul Sanctum
features.summary: Spirits shield you and punish foes.
features.descriptionHtml:
Spirits shield you and punish foes.

Action: for 1 minute, hostiles near you or your sentinel take force damage at turn start; attackers have disadvantage vs. you; hostiles have disadvantage on saves vs. your spells. Once per long rest.

Natural Adaptation. Choose one: Avian (fly speed = walk), Agile (climb speed = walk; advantage vs. prone), Aquatic (swim speed = walk; hold breath 20 min), or Sturdy (AC 13 + Fitness without armor; count as one size larger for carry capacity).

PG2 expansion: Fossorial (burrow 20 ft through soft earth) or Quillback (reaction quill strike when hit in melee).

heritages.body:
A telepathically linked community functioning as a collective—unity over individuality.

Unity. When you Help on a check, target gains +PB; when helped, you gain +PB from the helper.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.teaser: You have spent your life in service to a temple dedicated to a specific god or pantheon, acting as an intermediary between the divine and the mortal world—performing sacred rites, offering blessings, and conducting…
backgrounds.body:
You have spent your life in service to a temple dedicated to a specific god or pantheon, acting as an intermediary between the divine and the mortal world—performing sacred rites, offering blessings, and conducting worshipers into the presence of the divine. You aren't necessarily a cleric; performing sacred rites isn't the same as channeling divine power.

Those who share your faith support you (but only you) at a modest lifestyle, and you can expect free healing and care at any temple, shrine, or established presence of your faith, though you must still provide any material components needed for spells.

Skill Proficiencies: Insight and Religion.

Additional Proficiencies: Calligrapher's supplies, and two languages of your choice.

Equipment: A holy symbol, a prayer book or prayer wheel, 5 sticks of incense, vestments, common clothes, and a pouch containing 15 gp.

Talent: Choose one: Field Medic, Mental Fortitude, or Ritualist.
